# Janene's SOD

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="description" content="The NYS Career Map — An interactive career planning tool for 6th graders, styled as an RPG quest through the Legendary Horizon universe.">
  <title>The NYS Career Map — Legendary Horizon</title>
  <style>
/* ============================================================
   THE NYS CAREER MAP — Legendary Horizon Design System
   ============================================================ */

/* --- Google Fonts --- */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@400;600;700;900&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&display=swap');

/* --- Design Tokens --- */
:root {
  /* Legendary Horizon Palette */
  --bg-primary: #0a0c10;
  --bg-secondary: #111520;
  --bg-panel: rgba(17, 21, 32, 0.85);
  --bg-card: rgba(20, 25, 40, 0.9);
  --bg-input: rgba(15, 18, 28, 0.95);
  --bg-hover: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08);

  --accent-primary: #f59e0b;
  --accent-secondary: #d97706;
  --accent-glow: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
  --accent-glow-strong: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.55);
  --accent-subtle: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12);

  --text-primary: #f1f5f9;
  --text-secondary: #94a3b8;
  --text-muted: #64748b;
  --text-accent: #f59e0b;

  --border-default: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12);
  --border-accent: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);
  --border-accent-strong: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.6);

  --success: #22c55e;
  --success-glow: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3);
  --danger: #ef4444;
  --info: #3b82f6;

  /* Typography */
  --font-header: 'Cinzel', serif;
  --font-body: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
  --font-lore: 'Playfair Display', serif;

  /* Spacing */
  --space-xs: 0.25rem;
  --space-sm: 0.5rem;
  --space-md: 1rem;
  --space-lg: 1.5rem;
  --space-xl: 2rem;
  --space-2xl: 3rem;

  /* Radius */
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 10px;
  --radius-lg: 16px;
  --radius-xl: 24px;

  /* Shadows */
  --shadow-card: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  --shadow-glow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
  --shadow-glow-strong: 0 0 30px var(--accent-glow-strong);
  --shadow-input-focus: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-glow), 0 0 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);

  /* Layout */
  --sidebar-width: 260px;
  --header-height: 0px;

  /* Transitions */
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

/* --- Reset & Base --- */
*, *::before, *::after {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  font-size: 16px;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.65;
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* Ambient background texture */
body::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 800px 600px at 20% 30%, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.04), transparent),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 600px 400px at 80% 70%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.03), transparent);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

/* --- Scrollbar --- */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg-primary); }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--accent-secondary);
  border-radius: 3px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--accent-primary); }

/* --- Accent utility --- */
.accent {
  color: var(--accent-primary);
  text-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
}

/* --- Layout Shell --- */
.app-layout {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 100vh;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* --- Sidebar --- */
.sidebar {
  width: var(--sidebar-width);
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  z-index: 100;
  transition: transform 0.4s var(--ease-out);
}

.sidebar-header {
  padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-lg);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  text-align: center;
}

.sidebar-logo {
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.sidebar-logo .accent {
  color: var(--accent-primary);
  text-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
}

.sidebar-subtitle {
  font-family: var(--font-lore);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: var(--space-xs);
}

/* Progress Ring */
.progress-section {
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default);
}

.progress-ring-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 100px;
  height: 100px;
}

.progress-ring {
  transform: rotate(-90deg);
}

.progress-ring-bg {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--border-default);
  stroke-width: 6;
}

.progress-ring-fill {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--accent-primary);
  stroke-width: 6;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-dasharray: 251.2;
  stroke-dashoffset: 251.2;
  transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.8s var(--ease-out);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--accent-glow));
}

.progress-text {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.progress-percent {
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.progress-label {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

/* Nav Links */
.sidebar-nav {
  flex: 1;
  padding: var(--space-md) 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

.nav-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
  border-left: 3px solid transparent;
  position: relative;
}

.nav-item:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
}

.nav-item.active {
  background: var(--accent-subtle);
  border-left-color: var(--accent-primary);
}

.nav-item.active .nav-label {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.nav-item.active .nav-icon {
  color: var(--accent-primary);
  text-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent-glow);
}

.nav-icon {
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  width: 28px;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
}

.nav-label {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  transition: color 0.3s;
  flex: 1;
}

.nav-check {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--success);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}

.nav-check.visible {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Mobile menu toggle */
.mobile-toggle {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: var(--space-md);
  left: var(--space-md);
  z-index: 200;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
  color: var(--accent-primary);
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* Reset progress button */
.sidebar-footer {
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.sidebar-btn {
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md);
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.sidebar-btn:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--accent-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.reset-btn {
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md);
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3);
  color: var(--danger);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.reset-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1);
  border-color: var(--danger);
}

/* Audio Toggle Button */
.audio-toggle-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

.audio-toggle-btn:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  border-color: var(--border-accent);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

/* --- Main Content --- */
.main-content {
  flex: 1;
  margin-left: var(--sidebar-width);
  padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--space-2xl) var(--space-2xl) var(--space-2xl);
  max-width: 900px;
}

/* --- Module Sections --- */
.module-section {
  display: none;
  animation: fadeSlideIn 0.5s var(--ease-out);
}

.module-section.active {
  display: block;
}

@keyframes fadeSlideIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(16px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

/* Module Header */
.module-header {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
}

.module-number {
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  color: var(--accent-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.module-title {
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.module-lore {
  font-family: var(--font-lore);
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--accent-secondary);
  padding-left: var(--space-md);
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
}

/* --- Section Groups --- */
.section-group {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
}

.section-label {
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.section-label .icon {
  color: var(--accent-primary);
}

/* --- Section Helper (inline guidance for students) --- */
.section-helper {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-secondary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}

.helper-intro {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.helper-list {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.helper-list li {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.5;
  padding-left: var(--space-xs);
}

.helper-list li strong {
  color: var(--text-primary);
}

.helper-note {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--accent-primary);
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* --- Cards / Panels --- */
.card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
  position: relative;
}

.card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-accent);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.card-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.card-number {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  background: var(--accent-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent-primary);
}

.card-number.filled {
  background: var(--accent-primary);
  color: var(--bg-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

/* --- Form Elements --- */
.form-group {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.form-label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.form-input,
.form-textarea {
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--space-md);
  background: var(--bg-input);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
  outline: none;
}

.form-input::placeholder,
.form-textarea::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-style: italic;
}

.form-input:focus,
.form-textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-input-focus);
}

.form-textarea {
  resize: vertical;
  min-height: 80px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* --- Tooltip ("Why?") --- */
.tooltip-trigger {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  background: var(--accent-subtle);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent-primary);
  cursor: help;
  position: relative;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.tooltip-trigger:hover .tooltip-content {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.tooltip-content {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: calc(100% + 8px);
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(4px);
  background: var(--bg-secondary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md);
  font-family: var(--font-lore);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  max-width: 280px;
  white-space: normal;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: all 0.25s var(--ease-out);
  z-index: 50;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
}

.tooltip-content::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 100%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  border: 6px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: var(--border-accent);
}

/* --- Radio Group (Work Preference) --- */
.radio-group {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: var(--space-md);
}

.radio-option {
  position: relative;
}

.radio-option input[type="radio"] {
  position: absolute;
  opacity: 0;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
}

.radio-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-md);
  background: var(--bg-input);
  border: 2px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
  text-align: center;
}

.radio-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-accent);
  background: var(--bg-hover);
}

.radio-option input:checked + .radio-card {
  border-color: var(--accent-primary);
  background: var(--accent-subtle);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

.radio-card .radio-icon {
  font-size: 1.8rem;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.radio-card .radio-title {
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.radio-card .radio-desc {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* --- Work Path Cards (Module 1 - Work Preference) --- */
.work-path-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: var(--space-md);
}

.work-path-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  padding: var(--space-xl) var(--space-md);
  background: var(--bg-input);
  border: 2px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
  text-align: center;
}

.work-path-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-accent);
  background: var(--bg-hover);
}

.work-path-card.selected {
  border-color: var(--accent-primary);
  background: var(--accent-subtle);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

.work-path-icon {
  font-size: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.work-path-title {
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.work-path-label {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent-secondary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.work-path-desc {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.work-path-card.selected .work-path-title { color: var(--accent-primary); }
.work-path-card.selected .work-path-desc  { color: var(--text-secondary); }

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .work-path-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

/* --- Experience Cards (Module 2) --- */
.experience-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-md);
}

.experience-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-lg);
  position: relative;
  animation: fadeSlideIn 0.3s var(--ease-out);
}

.experience-card .remove-btn {
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--space-md);
  right: var(--space-md);
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 0.2s;
  padding: 4px;
  line-height: 1;
}

.experience-card .remove-btn:hover {
  color: var(--danger);
}

.experience-fields {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-md);
}

.add-card-btn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--space-md);
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px dashed var(--border-accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--accent-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
}

.add-card-btn:hover {
  background: var(--accent-subtle);
  border-color: var(--accent-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

/* --- Skill Sliders (Module 3) --- */
.skill-block {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
}

.skill-block:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-accent);
}

.skill-name {
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.skill-desc {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.skill-slider-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.skill-slider-label {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  min-width: 70px;
  text-align: right;
}

.star-rating {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-xs);
}

.star-btn {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--border-default);
  transition: all 0.2s var(--ease-spring);
  padding: 2px;
  line-height: 1;
}

.star-btn.active {
  color: var(--accent-primary);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--accent-glow));
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

.star-btn:hover {
  transform: scale(1.2);
}

.star-btn.star-locked {
  opacity: 0.25;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  filter: none;
}

.star-btn.star-locked:hover {
  transform: none;
}

.skill-value {
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent-primary);
  min-width: 30px;
  text-align: center;
}

.proof-box {
  position: relative;
}

.proof-box .form-label {
  color: var(--accent-secondary);
}

.proof-required {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--danger);
  margin-left: var(--space-xs);
}

.proof-box .form-textarea {
  border-color: var(--border-accent);
}

.proof-box .form-textarea:not(:placeholder-shown) {
  border-color: var(--success);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--success-glow);
}

/* --- Goal Fields (Module 4) --- */
.goal-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
}

.goal-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-accent);
}

.goal-icon {
  font-size: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.goal-title {
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xs);
}

.goal-hint {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

/* ── Tutorial scaffolding for COI + Goals sections ─────── */
.tutorial-examples {
  display: none; /* hidden by default — revealed by toggle */
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}
.tutorial-examples.open {
  display: grid;
  animation: tutorialSlide 0.3s ease-out;
}

/* Examples toggle button — purple to match the example cards */
.examples-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99,102,241,0.12), rgba(168,85,247,0.12));
  color: #4338ca;
  border: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.4);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-right: 8px;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.examples-toggle:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99,102,241,0.2), rgba(168,85,247,0.2));
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.examples-toggle .chev {
  transition: transform 0.2s;
}
.examples-toggle.open .chev {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}
.tutorial-example {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99,102,241,0.06), rgba(168,85,247,0.06));
  border: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.25);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.tutorial-example .tutorial-example-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #6366f1;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.tutorial-example .tutorial-example-quote {
  font-style: italic;
  opacity: 0.92;
}

.tutorial-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fef3c7, #fde68a);
  color: #78350f;
  border: 1px solid #fbbf24;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.tutorial-toggle:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fde68a, #fcd34d);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.tutorial-toggle .chev {
  transition: transform 0.2s;
}
.tutorial-toggle.open .chev {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.tutorial-panel {
  display: none;
  background: #fffbeb;
  border-left: 4px solid #f59e0b;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: #451a03;
}
.tutorial-panel.open {
  display: block;
  animation: tutorialSlide 0.3s ease-out;
}
@keyframes tutorialSlide {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.tutorial-panel h4 {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: #78350f;
  margin: 0 0 6px 0;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.tutorial-panel ol,
.tutorial-panel ul {
  margin: 6px 0 12px 0;
  padding-left: 22px;
}
.tutorial-panel ol li,
.tutorial-panel ul li {
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.tutorial-panel .starter {
  display: block;
  background: white;
  border: 1px dashed #fbbf24;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  margin: 4px 0;
  font-style: italic;
  color: #78350f;
  font-size: 0.83rem;
}
.tutorial-panel .personal-tip {
  background: #ecfdf5;
  border-left: 3px solid #10b981;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin-top: 10px;
  color: #065f46;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.tutorial-panel .personal-tip strong {
  color: #047857;
}
.tutorial-panel .last-resort {
  margin-top: 10px;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 1px dashed #fbbf24;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: #78350f;
}

/* --- Export / Quest Log View --- */
.export-section {
  display: none;
  animation: fadeSlideIn 0.5s var(--ease-out);
}

.export-section.active {
  display: block;
}

.export-header-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-md);
}

.copy-all-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-xl);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-secondary), var(--accent-primary));
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--bg-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

.copy-all-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow-strong);
}

/* --- Form Mirror View (NYS Official Site Clone) --- */
.site-hint {
  background: var(--accent-subtle);
  border: 1px dashed var(--border-accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.site-hint strong {
  color: var(--accent-primary);
}

.form-mirror-section {
  background: #f8fafc; /* Light background mimicking official form */
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  color: #1e293b; /* Dark slate text for form */
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
}

/* Pink variant — used by the Culminating Activity section so it stands apart */
.form-mirror-section-pink {
  background: #fdf2f8;
  border: 1px solid #fbcfe8;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.18);
}
.form-mirror-header-pink {
  color: #be185d !important;
  background: #fce7f3;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #fbcfe8;
}

.form-mirror-tab {
  color: #4f46e5;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg);
  padding-bottom: 0;
}

.form-mirror-header {
  color: #b91c1c; /* Crimson color matching site */
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.form-mirror-desc {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  padding: 0 var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  color: #334155;
}

.form-mirror-columns {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  padding: 0 var(--space-lg) var(--space-sm);
}

.form-mirror-col-header {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0f172a;
}

.form-mirror-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg);
  background: #ffffff;
  border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.form-mirror-skill-row {
  align-items: center;
}

.form-mirror-skill-name {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #0f172a;
}

.form-mirror-grade {
  flex: 0 0 60px;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 40px;
}

.form-mirror-grade::after {
  content: '▼';
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  color: #64748b;
}

.form-mirror-cell {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.form-mirror-field {
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #ffffff;
  padding: 6px;
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  position: relative;
  min-height: 80px;
}

.form-mirror-field.empty {
  background: #f8fafc;
}

.form-mirror-value {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #334155;
  padding: 4px;
  flex: 1;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.form-mirror-field.empty .form-mirror-value {
  color: #94a3b8;
  font-style: italic;
}

/* Empty-field warning that jumps back to the relevant Quest */
.form-mirror-field .empty-warning-btn {
  flex: 1;
  background: #fef2f2;
  border: 1px dashed #fca5a5;
  color: #b91c1c;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1.4;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.form-mirror-field .empty-warning-btn:hover {
  background: #fee2e2;
  border-color: #ef4444;
  border-style: solid;
}
.form-mirror-field .empty-warning-btn strong {
  color: #7f1d1d;
}

.form-mirror-field .copy-btn {
  align-self: flex-end;
  background: #f1f5f9;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  color: #475569;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-top: 8px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.form-mirror-field .copy-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: #e2e8f0;
  border-color: #94a3b8;
  color: #0f172a;
}

.form-mirror-field .copy-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.form-mirror-field .copy-btn.copied {
  background: #dcfce7;
  border-color: #22c55e;
  color: #166534;
}

/* --- Toast Notification --- */
.toast {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: var(--space-xl);
  right: var(--space-xl);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--success);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-xl);
  color: var(--success);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 0 0 20px var(--success-glow);
  transform: translateY(120%);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: all 0.4s var(--ease-spring);
  z-index: 1000;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.toast.show {
  transform: translateY(0);
  opacity: 1;
}

/* --- Navigation Buttons --- */
.nav-buttons {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-top: var(--space-2xl);
  padding-top: var(--space-xl);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default);
}

.btn-nav {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-xl);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
}

.btn-nav:hover {
  background: var(--accent-subtle);
  border-color: var(--accent-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

.btn-nav.primary {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-secondary), var(--accent-primary));
  border-color: var(--accent-primary);
  color: var(--bg-primary);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.btn-nav.primary:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow-strong);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.btn-nav:disabled {
  opacity: 0.3;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* --- Welcome Screen --- */
.welcome-card {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: var(--space-2xl);
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
  max-width: 600px;
  margin: var(--space-2xl) auto;
}

.welcome-icon {
  font-size: 3rem;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  animation: float 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-10px); }
}

.welcome-title {
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.welcome-desc {
  font-family: var(--font-lore);
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}

.welcome-name-group {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  max-width: 400px;
  margin: 0 auto var(--space-xl);
}

.welcome-name-group .form-input {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.begin-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-2xl);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-secondary), var(--accent-primary));
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  color: var(--bg-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
}

.begin-btn:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow-strong);
}

/* --- Responsive --- */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .mobile-toggle {
    display: flex;
  }

  .sidebar {
    transform: translateX(-100%);
  }

  .sidebar.open {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }

  .main-content {
    margin-left: 0;
    padding: var(--space-lg);
    padding-top: 70px;
  }

  .radio-group {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .experience-fields {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .export-header-bar {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .nav-buttons {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--space-md);
  }

  .btn-nav {
    justify-content: center;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .module-title {
    font-size: 1.3rem;
  }

  .welcome-name-group {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

/* --- Utility --- */
.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  border: 0;
}

.divider {
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--border-default);
  margin: var(--space-xl) 0;
}

/* --- Gamified Choice Grids --- */
.counter {
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1); 
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-primary);
  padding: 8px; 
  border-radius: var(--radius-md); 
  color: var(--accent-primary);
  text-align: center; 
  font-family: var(--font-header); 
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl); 
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.counter.locked {
  background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.1);
  border-color: #22c55e;
  color: #22c55e;
}

.tree-label { 
  font-size: 0.75rem; 
  font-weight: 800; 
  text-transform: uppercase; 
  letter-spacing: 1.5px; 
  margin: 20px 0 10px 0; 
  color: var(--text-primary); 
  border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border-default); 
  padding-bottom: 5px; 
}
.interest-tags { 
  display: flex; 
  flex-wrap: wrap; 
  gap: 8px; 
  margin-bottom: 15px; 
}
.tag { 
  background: var(--bg-input); 
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default); 
  color: var(--text-secondary); 
  padding: 8px 14px; 
  border-radius: 20px; 
  font-size: 0.85rem; 
  cursor: pointer; 
  transition: all 0.2s ease; 
  display: inline-flex; 
  align-items: center; 
  gap: 6px; 
}
.tag:hover { 
  border-color: var(--accent-primary); 
  color: white; 
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); 
}
.tag.selected { 
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); 
  border-color: var(--accent-primary); 
  color: white; 
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--shadow-glow); 
}

.class-grid { 
  display: grid; 
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(130px, 1fr)); 
  gap: 10px; 
}
.class-btn { 
  background: var(--bg-input); 
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default); 
  color: var(--text-secondary); 
  padding: 15px 10px; 
  border-radius: var(--radius-md); 
  font-size: 0.85rem; 
  cursor: pointer; 
  transition: all 0.2s ease; 
  display: flex; 
  flex-direction: column; 
  align-items: center; 
  gap: 8px; 
  text-align: center; 
}
.class-btn:hover { 
  border-color: #3b82f6; 
  color: white; 
}
.class-btn.selected { 
  background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); 
  border-color: #3b82f6; 
  color: white; 
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); 
  transform: translateY(-3px); 
}
.class-btn .emoji { font-size: 1.5rem; }

.skill-section-label { 
  font-size: 0.75rem; 
  font-weight: 800; 
  text-transform: uppercase; 
  letter-spacing: 1.5px; 
  margin: 20px 0 10px 0; 
  color: var(--text-primary); 
  border-left: 3px solid #10b981; 
  padding-left: 10px; 
}
.skill-grid { 
  display: grid; 
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(230px, 1fr)); 
  gap: 12px; 
  margin-bottom: 20px; 
}
.skill-card { 
  background: var(--bg-input); 
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default); 
  color: var(--text-secondary); 
  padding: 15px; 
  border-radius: var(--radius-md); 
  cursor: pointer; 
  transition: all 0.2s ease; 
  display: flex; 
  flex-direction: column; 
  gap: 5px; 
  position: relative; 
}
.skill-card:hover { 
  border-color: #10b981; 
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); 
}
.skill-card.selected { 
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); 
  border-color: #10b981; 
  color: white; 
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3); 
}
.skill-name { 
  font-weight: 700; 
  font-size: 0.95rem; 
  color: var(--text-primary); 
  display: flex; 
  align-items: center; 
  gap: 8px; 
}
.skill-desc { 
  font-size: 0.75rem; 
  line-height: 1.4; 
  color: var(--text-secondary); 
}
.skill-card.selected .skill-desc { color: #d1fae5; }

/* --- Toast Notification (grid limit warning) --- */
.toast {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 24px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(80px);
  background: #e11d48;
  color: white;
  padding: 12px 24px;
  border-radius: 50px;
  font-family: var(--font-header);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease;
  z-index: 9999;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.4);
}

.toast.show {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
}

/* === PART 2: Growth & Fortification === */
.skill-card.grow-selected {
  border-color: #f43f5e;
  background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.1);
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.3);
}
.skill-card.grow-selected .skill-name { color: #fda4af; }
.skill-card.grow-selected .skill-desc { color: #fecdd3; }

.action-input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid #f43f5e;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  color: white;
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  margin-top: 12px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: none;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}
.action-input::placeholder { color: rgba(253, 164, 175, 0.5); }
.action-input:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #fb7185;
  background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.15);
}
.skill-card.grow-selected .action-input { display: block; }

.grow-counter {
  background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.1);
  border: 1px solid #f43f5e;
  color: #f43f5e;
}

/* === PART 3: Experience Prompt Tiles === */
.exp-tiles-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.exp-tile {
  background: var(--bg-input);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-default);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 16px 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.exp-tile:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent-primary);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
}
.exp-tile.open {
  border-color: var(--accent-primary);
  background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--shadow-glow);
}
.exp-tile-emoji { font-size: 1.6rem; }
.exp-tile-label {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.exp-tile-sublabel {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
}
.exp-tile-inputs {
  display: none;
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
  padding: var(--space-md);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--accent-primary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--shadow-glow);
  animation: fadeSlideIn 0.3s ease;
}
.exp-tile-inputs.visible { display: block; }
.exp-tile-inputs .form-label {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.exp-tile-inputs .form-input {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}
.exp-tile-inputs .form-input:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
.tile-close-btn {
  display: block;
  margin-top: var(--space-sm);
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: right;
  width: 100%;
}
.tile-close-btn:hover { color: #f43f5e; }

</style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- Mobile Menu Toggle -->
  <button class="mobile-toggle" id="mobile-toggle" aria-label="Toggle navigation">☰</button>

  <!-- Toast Notification -->
  <div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

  <div class="app-layout">

    <!-- ═══════════ SIDEBAR ═══════════ -->
    <aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
      <div class="sidebar-header">
        <div class="sidebar-logo">The <span class="accent">NYS</span> Career Map</div>
        <div class="sidebar-subtitle">"Chart your path through the Legendary Horizon"</div>
        <button id="audio-toggle" class="audio-toggle-btn" aria-label="Toggle music" title="Toggle Music">🔊</button>
      </div>

      <!-- Progress Ring -->
      <div class="progress-section">
        <div class="progress-ring-container">
          <svg class="progress-ring" width="100" height="100" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
            <circle class="progress-ring-bg" cx="50" cy="50" r="40" />
            <circle class="progress-ring-fill" cx="50" cy="50" r="40" />
          </svg>
          <div class="progress-text">
            <span class="progress-percent">0%</span>
            <span class="progress-label">Complete</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Navigation -->
      <nav class="sidebar-nav" aria-label="Module navigation">
        <div class="nav-item" data-module="self-knowledge" id="nav-self-knowledge">
          <span class="nav-icon">⚔</span>
          <span class="nav-label">Who Am I?</span>
          <span class="nav-check">✓</span>
        </div>
        <div class="nav-item" data-module="career-exploration" id="nav-career-exploration">
          <span class="nav-icon">🗺</span>
          <span class="nav-label">Where Am I Going?</span>
          <span class="nav-check">✓</span>
        </div>
        <div class="nav-item" data-module="skills-assessment" id="nav-skills-assessment">
          <span class="nav-icon">⚡</span>
          <span class="nav-label">My Skills</span>
          <span class="nav-check">✓</span>
        </div>
        <div class="nav-item" data-module="goal-setting" id="nav-goal-setting">
          <span class="nav-icon">🎯</span>
          <span class="nav-label">My Goals</span>
          <span class="nav-check">✓</span>
        </div>
        <div class="nav-item" data-module="export" id="nav-export">
          <span class="nav-icon">📜</span>
          <span class="nav-label">Quest Log</span>
          <span class="nav-check">✓</span>
        </div>
      </nav>

      <div class="sidebar-footer">

        <button class="reset-btn" id="reset-btn">⚠ Reset All Progress</button>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <!-- ═══════════ MAIN CONTENT ═══════════ -->
    <main class="main-content">

      <!-- ────── WELCOME ────── -->
      <section class="module-section welcome-section active" id="module-welcome">
        <div class="welcome-card">
          <div class="welcome-icon">📜</div>
          <h1 class="welcome-title">Welcome, <span class="accent">Traveler</span></h1>
          <p class="welcome-desc">
            Every legendary journey begins with a single step. This quest will help you
            discover who you are, explore where you're going, sharpen your skills,
            and set goals for your future. Your answers here will become your
            <strong>Quest Log</strong> — a map you can carry forward.
          </p>
          <div class="welcome-name-group">
            <input
              type="text"
              class="form-input"
              id="student-name"
              placeholder="Enter your name, Traveler..."
              aria-label="Your name"
              maxlength="60"
            >
          </div>
          <button class="begin-btn" id="begin-btn">Begin Your Journey ⚔</button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ────── MODULE 1: SELF-KNOWLEDGE ────── -->
      <section class="module-section" id="module-self-knowledge">
        <div class="module-header">
          <div class="module-number">Quest I</div>
          <h2 class="module-title">Self-Knowledge: Who Am I?</h2>
          <p class="module-lore">
            "Before every great journey begins, a Traveler must know themselves.
            Look inward and fill in your Character Sheet."
          </p>
        </div>

        <!-- Personal Interests -->
        <div class="section-group">
          <div class="section-label">
            <span class="icon">🎮</span>
            Fun Stuff I Do Outside of School
          </div>
          <div class="section-helper">
            <p class="helper-intro">Knowing what you love doing for fun helps you find a career you'll actually enjoy! Think about hobbies, sports, games, and activities.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="card">
            <div class="counter" id="interest-counter">Select 3 Interest Orbs to continue (0/3)</div>
            <div id="interest-container">
              <p class="tree-label" style="color: #3b82f6;">The Tech Wizard</p>
              <div class="interest-tags">
                <button class="tag" data-value="Gaming">🎮 Gaming</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Coding">💻 Coding</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Robotics">🛠️ Robotics</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Video Editing">🎬 Video Editing</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="3D Printing">🖨️ 3D Printing</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Graphic Design">✏️ Graphic Design</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Streaming">🎥 Streaming</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Building PCs">🖥️ Building PCs</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Cybersecurity">🛡️ Cybersecurity</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="AI Tools">🤖 AI Tools</button>
              </div>
              <p class="tree-label" style="color: #ec4899;">The Creative Bard</p>
              <div class="interest-tags">
                <button class="tag" data-value="Drawing">🎨 Drawing</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Anime/Comics">💥 Anime & Comics</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Writing">📝 Writing</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Instruments">🎸 Instruments</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Singing">🎤 Singing</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Acting">🎭 Acting</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Dancing">💃 Dancing</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Fashion">👗 Fashion</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Photography">📸 Photography</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Crafts">🧶 Crafts</button>
              </div>
              <p class="tree-label" style="color: #f59e0b;">The Keeper of Light</p>
              <div class="interest-tags">
                <button class="tag" data-value="Youth Group">⛪ Youth Group</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Worship Team">🎵 Worship Team</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Sunday School">📖 Sunday School</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Food Banks">🍞 Food Banks</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Animal Shelters">🐶 Animal Shelters</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Scouts">🏕️ Scouts</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Neighborhood Help">🏠 Neighborhood Help</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Charity Events">🎗️ Charity Events</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Bible Study">📜 Bible Study</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Volunteering">🤝 Volunteering</button>
              </div>
              <p class="tree-label" style="color: #ef4444;">The Vanguard</p>
              <div class="interest-tags">
                <button class="tag" data-value="Soccer">⚽ Soccer</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Basketball">🏀 Basketball</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Gymnastics">🤸 Gymnastics</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Martial Arts">🥋 Martial Arts</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Skating">🛹 Skating</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Swimming">🏊 Swimming</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Biking">🚲 Biking</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Hiking">🥾 Hiking</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Cheer">📣 Cheer</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Volleyball">🏐 Volleyball</button>
              </div>
              <p class="tree-label" style="color: #10b981;">The Alchemist</p>
              <div class="interest-tags">
                <button class="tag" data-value="LEGOs/Models">🧱 LEGOs/Models</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Cooking">🧁 Cooking</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Baking">🍰 Baking</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Woodworking">🔨 Woodworking</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Science">🧪 Science</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Space">🚀 Space</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Gardening">🌱 Gardening</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Magic">🪄 Magic</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Puzzles">🧩 Puzzles</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Forensics">🕵️ Forensics</button>
              </div>
              <p class="tree-label" style="color: #8b5cf6;">The Sage</p>
              <div class="interest-tags">
                <button class="tag" data-value="Reading">📚 Reading</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Student Council">🗳️ Student Council</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Entrepreneur">🍋 Entrepreneur</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="History">🏛️ History</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Collecting">🗃️ Collecting</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Languages">🗣️ Languages</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Chess">♟️ Chess</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Traveling">✈️ Traveling</button>
                <button class="tag" data-value="Public Speaking">🎤 Public Speaking</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div style="margin-top: 30px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default); padding-top: 20px;">
              <label class="tree-label" style="border:none;">Custom Enchantment</label>
              <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px;">
                <input type="text" id="custom-interest-in" class="form-input" placeholder="Type your own..." style="margin:0;">
                <button id="add-interest-btn" class="btn" style="padding: 0 15px;">Add</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Academic Interests -->
        <div class="section-group">
          <div class="section-label">
            <span class="icon">📚</span>
            Classes or Subjects I Like the Most
          </div>
          <div class="section-helper">
            <p class="helper-intro">Your favorite school subjects are clues to your future career path! Think about which classes make you excited to learn.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="card">
            <div class="counter" id="class-counter">Select 3 Favorite Subjects (0/3)</div>
            <div class="class-grid" id="class-container">
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="English Language Arts"><span class="emoji">📖</span><span>Language Arts</span></button>
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="Mathematics"><span class="emoji">📐</span><span>Mathematics</span></button>
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="Science"><span class="emoji">🧪</span><span>Science</span></button>
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="Social Studies"><span class="emoji">🌎</span><span>Social Studies</span></button>
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="Physical Education"><span class="emoji">🏃</span><span>Physical Ed.</span></button>
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="Art"><span class="emoji">🎨</span><span>Art</span></button>
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="Music"><span class="emoji">🎶</span><span>Music / Band</span></button>
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="FCS"><span class="emoji">🧑‍🧒‍🧒</span><span>Home &amp; Careers</span></button>
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="Reading"><span class="emoji">📖</span><span>Reading</span></button>
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="Band"><span class="emoji">🎺</span><span>Band</span></button>
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="Orchestra"><span class="emoji">🎻</span><span>Orchestra</span></button>
              <button class="class-btn" data-value="Chorus"><span class="emoji">🎤</span><span>Chorus</span></button>
            </div>
            
            <div style="margin-top: 30px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default); padding-top: 20px;">
              <label class="tree-label" style="border:none;">Custom Subject</label>
              <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px;">
                <input type="text" id="custom-class-in" class="form-input" placeholder="Type your own..." style="margin:0;">
                <button id="add-class-btn" class="btn" style="padding: 0 15px;">Add</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Work Preference -->
        <div class="section-group">
          <div class="section-label">
            <span class="icon">⚒</span>
            I Like Working With...
          </div>
          <div class="section-helper">
            <p class="helper-intro">This helps you figure out what kind of work environment fits you best. There's no wrong answer — just pick what feels most like you!</p>
          </div>

          <div class="work-path-grid" id="work-pref-container">
            <div class="work-path-card" data-value="people">
              <div class="work-path-icon">🤝</div>
              <div class="work-path-title">The Social Guild</div>
              <div class="work-path-label">Working with People</div>
              <div class="work-path-desc">Thrives in teams, helping the community, and making connections.</div>
            </div>
            <div class="work-path-card" data-value="ideas">
              <div class="work-path-icon">💭</div>
              <div class="work-path-title">The Sage Circle</div>
              <div class="work-path-label">Working with Ideas</div>
              <div class="work-path-desc">Solving puzzles, dreaming up new worlds, and thinking creatively.</div>
            </div>
            <div class="work-path-card" data-value="things">
              <div class="work-path-icon">🛠️</div>
              <div class="work-path-title">The Forge Masters</div>
              <div class="work-path-label">Working with Things</div>
              <div class="work-path-desc">Building with tools, fixing gear, and making things with your hands.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Hero Attributes (Abilities) -->
        <div class="section-group">
          <div class="section-label">
            <span class="icon">✨</span>
            Hero Attributes (Abilities)
          </div>
          <div class="section-helper">
            <p class="helper-intro">Everyone has natural superpowers. Choose the ones that fit you best!</p>
          </div>
          
          <div class="card">
            <div class="counter" id="skill-counter">Identify 1-2 Natural Superpowers (0/2)</div>
            
            <div id="skill-container">
              <div class="skill-section-label">⚡ Part 1: Physical Abilities</div>
              <div class="skill-grid">
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Awareness & Focus" data-desc="Seeing, hearing, and taking in lots of information at once to figure out exactly what it means.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>👁️</span> Awareness & Focus</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Being a great listener and observer who can take in lots of information at once.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Body Control" data-desc="Moving with balance and purpose; flexibility, steadiness, and physical strength.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>🤸</span> Body Control</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Moving with balance and purpose; flexibility, steadiness, and physical strength.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Precision & Reaction" data-desc="Careful hand-work (building/typing) and responding instantly to signals or sounds.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>⚡</span> Precision & Reaction</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Careful hand-work (building/typing) and responding instantly to signals or sounds.</div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="skill-section-label">🧠 Part 2: Cognitive (Thinking) Abilities</div>
              <div class="skill-grid">
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Communication" data-desc="Sharing ideas clearly through speaking and writing, and understanding what others tell you.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>📢</span> Communication</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Sharing ideas clearly through speaking/writing and understanding others.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Logical Reasoning" data-desc="Spotting problems before they happen and thinking of clever, rule-based ways to fix them.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>🧩</span> Logical Reasoning</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Spotting problems and thinking of clever, rule-based ways to fix them.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Creative Thinking" data-desc="Coming up with original ideas or new ways to solve old problems, and picturing things that don't exist yet.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>🎨</span> Creative Thinking</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Coming up with original ideas and new ways to solve old problems.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Math & Data" data-desc="Working with patterns, doing math quickly, and finding hidden info in charts or pictures.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>🔢</span> Math & Data</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Working with patterns and finding hidden info in numbers and charts.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Memory & Attention" data-desc="Staying focused without distraction and switching between different tasks smoothly.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>🎯</span> Memory & Attention</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Staying focused without distraction and switching between tasks smoothly.</div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="skill-section-label">🚀 Part 3: Modern Career Skills</div>
              <div class="skill-grid">
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Digital Literacy" data-desc="Using technology and the internet safely to find information or create new projects.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>💻</span> Digital Literacy</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Using technology safely to find information or create projects.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Collaboration" data-desc="Working well with others, listening to opinions, and helping a group reach a shared goal.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>🤝</span> Collaboration</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Working well with others and helping a group reach a shared goal.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Self-Management" data-desc="Staying organized, tracking your own work, and managing time to meet deadlines.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>📅</span> Self-Management</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Staying organized and managing time to meet deadlines.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="skill-card" data-value="Adaptability" data-desc="Staying calm and trying a new approach when things change or the first plan fails.">
                  <div class="skill-name"><span>🌊</span> Adaptability</div>
                  <div class="skill-desc">Staying calm and trying new approaches when things change.</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <div style="margin-top: 30px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default); padding-top: 20px;">
              <label class="tree-label" style="border:none;">Custom Superhero Trait</label>
              <div style="display: flex; gap: 10px;">
                <input type="text" id="custom-skill-in" class="form-input" placeholder="Type your own..." style="margin:0;">
                <button id="add-skill-btn" class="btn" style="padding: 0 15px;">Add</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Growth & Fortification -->
        <div class="section-group">
          <div class="section-label">
            <span class="icon">🌱</span>
            Forge Your Future Self
          </div>
          <div class="section-helper">
            <p class="helper-intro">Every hero has something they can improve. Pick <strong>2–3 areas</strong> you want to get better at — then write <strong>one action</strong> you'll actually take to level up that skill. Click a card to select it and unlock the action field.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="card">
            <div class="counter grow-counter" id="grow-counter">Select 2–3 Areas to Strengthen (0/3)</div>
            <div class="skill-grid" id="grow-container">
              <div class="skill-card grow-card" data-value="Critical Thinking">

                <h4>What to write here</h4>
                <p>How many years of school does someone need to do this job? What kind of school?</p>
                <h4>Find this in your project. Look for words like:</h4>
                <ul>
                  <li>"Bachelor's degree" (= 4 years of college)</li>
                  <li>"Master's degree" (= 2 more years after college)</li>
                  <li>"Doctorate" or "PhD" (= many more years)</li>
                  <li>"High school diploma" (= what you'll get when you finish 12th grade)</li>
                  <li>"Apprenticeship" (= learning on the job from someone experienced)</li>
                  <li>"Certificate" (= a short program, sometimes a few months to 2 years)</li>
                </ul>
                <h4>Try a sentence starter:</h4>
                <span class="starter">To become a ______, you need to finish high school and then ______.</span>

You can also check the career page in <strong>MaiaLearning → Careers</strong>.</div>

                </div>
                <div class="tutorial-example">

              <div class="tutorial-panel" id="tut-coi-env">
                <h4>Walk through these 5 questions for your career:</h4>
                <ol>
                  <li><strong>Inside or outside?</strong> (office, hospital, restaurant... or forest, ocean, construction site?)</li>
                  <li><strong>Alone or with people?</strong> (mostly by yourself... or with coworkers, customers, patients?)</li>
                  <li><strong>Fast or slow paced?</strong> (lots of urgent things happening... or steady and calm?)</li>
                  <li><strong>Loud or quiet?</strong> (noisy machines, lots of talking... or peaceful and silent?)</li>
                  <li><strong>High or low pressure?</strong> (mistakes have big consequences... or it's okay to take your time?)</li>
                </ol>
                <h4>Try a sentence starter:</h4>

          <h2 class="module-title">Future Goals & Decision Making: How Do I Get There?</h2>
          <p class="module-lore">

        <div class="goal-card">
          <div class="goal-icon">🌟</div>
          <div class="goal-title">Goals — Getting Ready for the Workforce</div>
          <div class="goal-hint"><strong>In your own words:</strong> Now that you have researched about careers, what is one thing you plan to do to get ready for the workforce?</div>
          <div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:8px;font-style:italic;">📋 This will go into MaiaLearning → "Goals (resulting from career exploration activities)"</div>

          <button type="button" class="examples-toggle" data-toggle-examples="ex-goal">


            📚 Show examples <span class="chev">▼</span>


          </button>


          <div class="tutorial-examples" id="ex-goal">
            <div class="tutorial-example">
              <span class="tutorial-example-name">Maya wrote:</span>
              <span class="tutorial-example-quote">"My goal is to keep researching jobs that work with animals so I can decide between vet, zookeeper, and trainer."</span>
            </div>
            <div class="tutorial-example">
              <span class="tutorial-example-name">Jordan wrote:</span>
              <span class="tutorial-example-quote">"I plan to start learning how to code on my own so I can build small games before I get to high school."</span>
            </div>
            <div class="tutorial-example">
              <span class="tutorial-example-name">Sam wrote:</span>

          <button type="button" class="tutorial-toggle" data-toggle="tut-goal">
            💡 Help me think through this <span class="chev">▼</span>
          </button>
          <div class="tutorial-panel" id="tut-goal">
            <h4>What is a "goal"?</h4>
            <p>A goal is something you <strong>plan to do</strong> over time to get ready for the future. It's bigger than a single action — it's a direction.</p>
            <h4>Walk through these questions:</h4>
            <ol>
              <li>What career did I research? (Look at the section above 👆)</li>
              <li>What's <strong>one thing</strong> I could do over the next few years to learn more about it or get better at it?</li>
              <li>Why does that matter to me?</li>
            </ol>
            <h4>Try a sentence starter:</h4>
            <span class="starter">My goal is to ______ so I can ______.</span>
            <span class="starter">I plan to ______ because I'm interested in ______.</span>
            <span class="starter">One thing I'll do is keep learning about ______ so I'm ready for a job in ______.</span>
            <div class="personal-tip" id="goal-tip" style="display:none;">
              💡 <strong>Tip from your earlier answers:</strong> <span id="goal-tip-text"></span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="form-group">
            <textarea class="form-textarea" id="career-goal" placeholder="Write your goal here — what's one thing you plan to do?" rows="3" maxlength="1000"></textarea>
          </div>

        <div class="goal-card">

          <div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:8px;font-style:italic;">📋 This will go into MaiaLearning → "Education Plans (courses that relate to my career interests)"</div>

          <button type="button" class="examples-toggle" data-toggle-examples="ex-edu">

            </div>
            <div class="tutorial-example">

          <button type="button" class="tutorial-toggle" data-toggle="tut-edu">

          <div class="tutorial-panel" id="tut-edu">
            <h4>What classes connect to my career?</h4>
            <p>Almost every job uses school skills. The trick is figuring out <strong>which</strong> ones matter most for the career you researched.</p>
            <h4>Match careers to classes:</h4>
            <ul>
              <li><strong>Working with animals or nature?</strong> → Science, Biology</li>
              <li><strong>Health or medicine</strong> (doctor, nurse, dentist, EMT)? → Science, Biology, Health, Math</li>
              <li><strong>Building or designing</strong> (architect, engineer, contractor)? → Math, Art, Tech/Shop classes</li>
              <li><strong>Coding or technology</strong> (game design, IT, programming)? → Math, Tech/Computers, Art</li>
              <li><strong>Helping people</strong> (counselor, social worker, therapist)? → English, Health, Social Studies</li>
              <li><strong>Teaching or training</strong>? → English, your favorite subject, Public Speaking</li>
              <li><strong>Performing or creating</strong> (actor, musician, artist, writer)? → Art, Music, English</li>
              <li><strong>Communications & media</strong> (journalist, video producer, marketing)? → English, Art, Tech, Social Studies</li>
              <li><strong>Business or money</strong> (manager, accountant, finance)? → Math, Social Studies, English</li>
              <li><strong>Sports or fitness</strong> (coach, trainer, PE teacher)? → P.E., Health, Science</li>
              <li><strong>Working with hands</strong> (electrician, mechanic, plumber, carpenter)? → Math, Tech/Shop classes</li>
              <li><strong>Public safety</strong> (police, firefighter, EMT, military)? → P.E., Health, Social Studies, Science</li>
              <li><strong>Law or government</strong> (lawyer, judge, politician)? → Social Studies, English, Public Speaking</li>
              <li><strong>Hospitality or food</strong> (chef, hotel manager, event planner)? → Math, Health, Languages</li>
              <li><strong>Transportation</strong> (pilot, truck driver, logistics)? → Math, Geography, Tech/Shop</li>
              <li><strong>Farming, food, or natural resources</strong>? → Science, Biology, Math, Tech/Shop</li>
              <li><strong>Science, research, or engineering</strong>? → Math, Science, Tech/Computers</li>
            </ul>
            <h4>Try a sentence starter:</h4>
            <span class="starter">I should pay more attention in ______ because ______ uses it for ______.</span>
            <span class="starter">The classes that connect to my career are ______ and ______.</span>
            <div class="personal-tip" id="edu-tip" style="display:none;">
              💡 <strong>From your favorite classes:</strong> <span id="edu-tip-text"></span>

        <div class="goal-card">

          <div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:8px;font-style:italic;">📋 This will go into MaiaLearning → "Action Steps (What I need to do to accomplish my goals)"</div>

          <button type="button" class="examples-toggle" data-toggle-examples="ex-action">

          <div class="tutorial-examples" id="ex-action">

            </div>
            <div class="tutorial-example">

            </div>
            <div class="tutorial-example">

          <button type="button" class="tutorial-toggle" data-toggle="tut-action">
            💡 Help me think through this <span class="chev">▼</span>
          </button>
          <div class="tutorial-panel" id="tut-action">
            <h4>What's a good action step?</h4>
            <p>A goal is the <em>direction</em>. An action step is <strong>one specific thing you can actually do</strong> — small enough that you could start it this week.</p>
            <h4>A good action step is:</h4>
            <ul>
              <li>✅ <strong>Specific</strong> — not "do better" but "join X" or "read Y"</li>
              <li>✅ <strong>Doable this year</strong> — not in 5 years, this year</li>
              <li>✅ <strong>Connected to your goal</strong> — it should help with the career you wrote about</li>
            </ul>
            <h4>Examples of action steps a 6th grader could actually do:</h4>
            <ul>
              <li>Join a club (science club, art club, drama, robotics, sports team)</li>
              <li>Volunteer somewhere connected to your career</li>
              <li>Ask a teacher for help in your weakest class</li>
              <li>Read a book or watch documentaries about your career</li>
              <li>Interview someone who has the job</li>
              <li>Start a small project at home (build something, draw something, write something)</li>
            </ul>
            <h4>Try a sentence starter:</h4>
            <span class="starter">This year I'm going to ______ so I can ______.</span>
            <span class="starter">I will ______ every (week / month) to get better at ______.</span>
            <div class="personal-tip" id="action-tip" style="display:none;">
              💡 <strong>From your hobbies:</strong> <span id="action-tip-text"></span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="form-group">

          <div class="goal-title">Completed Steps</div>
          <div class="goal-hint">Have you already completed your action step? Pick <strong>No</strong> if you're still working on it (most 6th graders pick No — that's normal!).</div>
          <div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:8px;font-style:italic;">📋 This will go into MaiaLearning → "Completed Steps"</div>

    </main>
  </div>

  <audio id="bgm" loop src="data:audio/mpeg;base64,"></audio>
  <script>
/* ============================================================
   THE NYS CAREER MAP — Application Logic
   ============================================================ */

(function () {
  'use strict';

  // ── Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const STORAGE_KEY = 'nys-career-map-data';
  const MODULES = ['welcome', 'self-knowledge', 'career-exploration', 'skills-assessment', 'goal-setting', 'export'];

  const SKILLS = [
    {
      id: "basic",
      name: "Reading, Writing & Math",
      officialName: "Basic Skills",
      desc: "Use a combination of techniques to read, listen to, and analyze complex information; conveys information in oral and written form; uses multiple computational skills to analyze and solve mathematical problems.",
      examples: [
        "Literary Analysis of The False Prince",
        "Reading and summarizing a news article from the Democrat & Chronicle",
        "Calculating the cost and change during a school store transaction",
        "Writing a persuasive letter to the school board",
        "Listening to a podcast episode and identifying the main argument",
        "Solving a multi-step word problem using a real budget scenario",
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "thinking",
      name: "Figuring Things Out",
      officialName: "Thinking Skills",
      desc: "Demonstrates the ability to organize & process information and apply skills in new ways.",
      examples: [
        "Graphic organizers",
        "Creating a Venn diagram comparing two historical figures",
        "Sorting current events into cause-and-effect charts",
        "Using a KWL chart before and after a science unit",
        "Building a concept map for a social studies chapter",
        "Designing a flowchart for a school project process",
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "personal",
      name: "Being My Best Self",
      officialName: "Personal Qualities",
      desc: "Demonstrates skills in setting goals, monitoring progress, and improving progress.",
      examples: [
        "Created goals in Leader in Me",
        "Tracking reading log minutes weekly and adjusting pace to meet a goal",
        "Completing a reflection after a failed test and making a study plan",
        "Using a habit tracker for homework completion across one month",
        "Setting a fitness goal in PE and recording progress",
        "Identifying a personal weakness and choosing one strategy to address it",
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "interpersonal",
      name: "Working With Others",
      officialName: "Interpersonal Skills",
      desc: "Communicates effectively and helps others to learn a new skill.",
      examples: [
        "Any team sport in PE class or any group work",
        "Explaining a math strategy to a partner who didn't understand it",
        "Taking on a speaking role in a group presentation",
        "Resolving a disagreement during a group project without adult intervention",
        "Peer-editing a classmate's writing using specific, constructive feedback",
        "Leading a small group through a science lab procedure",
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "technology",
      name: "Using Tech to Solve Problems",
      officialName: "Technology",
      desc: "Applies knowledge of technology to identify and solve problems.",
      examples: [
        "Uses Chromebook",
        "Using Google Slides to present a research project",
        "Troubleshooting a formatting issue in a Google Doc independently",
        "Creating a digital poster using Canva or Book Creator",
        "Using an online graphing tool to display collected data",
        "Evaluating a website for credibility using a checklist",
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "info",
      name: "Finding & Using Information",
      officialName: "Managing Information",
      desc: "Uses technology to acquire, analyze and organize data, and communicates information.",
      examples: [
        "Any science or H&C lab",
        "Recording observations across multiple trials in a science experiment and identifying patterns",
        "Researching Greece, NY's history using two different sources and comparing them",
        "Organizing survey results from classmates into a table and drawing a conclusion",
        "Taking structured notes from a video using a two-column format",
        "Summarizing key points from three sources into one coherent paragraph",
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "resources",
      name: "Managing Time & Resources",
      officialName: "Managing Resources",
      desc: "Allocates time and financial and human resources to complete a task.",
      examples: [
        "Using your agenda",
        "Planning the steps and timeline for a multi-day project backward from the due date",
        "Dividing responsibilities fairly among group members for a class project",
        "Estimating whether a hypothetical $20 budget covers supplies for a school art project",
        "Prioritizing three homework assignments by deadline and difficulty",
        "Creating a weekly schedule that balances homework, activities, and downtime",
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "systems",
      name: "Understanding How Things Work Together",
      officialName: "Systems",
```
