      desc: "Demonstrates an understanding of the relationship between the performance of a system and the goals, resources, and functions of an organization.",
      examples: [
        "Using info from town meetings / code of conduct to manage being a student at ATHM",
        "Mapping how the school day schedule connects to learning goals and building rules",
        "Explaining how Greece Central's attendance policy connects to student outcomes",
        "Tracing how a school supply request moves from student to teacher to administration",
        "Analyzing how classroom jobs keep the system running",
        "Comparing how two school clubs operate differently to achieve similar goals",
      ],
    },
  ];

  // ── Ability → Career suggestions map ────────────────────
  const ABILITY_CAREERS = {
    "Awareness & Focus":   "Air Traffic Controller, Detective, Surgeon",
    "Body Control":        "Physical Therapist, Professional Athlete, Dance Instructor",
    "Precision & Reaction":"Electrician, Video Game Developer, Emergency Responder",
    "Communication":       "Teacher, Journalist, Lawyer",
    "Logical Reasoning":   "Engineer, Computer Scientist, Accountant",
    "Creative Thinking":   "Graphic Designer, Architect, Writer",
    "Math & Data":         "Data Scientist, Financial Analyst, Actuary",
    "Memory & Attention":  "Doctor, Researcher, Pilot",
    "Digital Literacy":    "Software Developer, IT Specialist, UX Designer",
    "Collaboration":       "Human Resources Manager, Coach, Counselor",
    "Self-Management":     "Entrepreneur, Project Manager, Nurse",
    "Adaptability":        "Emergency Medical Technician, Travel Consultant, Crisis Manager",
  };

  // ── Soft / Employment Skills (6th-grade level) ────────────
  // Used by the School/Community + Work experience dropdowns.
  // Plain language so an 11-year-old can self-identify.
  const SOFT_SKILLS = [
    "Teamwork — working well with others",
    "Listening carefully",
    "Following directions",
    "Communicating clearly (speaking & writing)",
    "Responsibility — doing what I said I would do",
    "Time management — being on time & finishing on time",
    "Patience",
    "Problem-solving — figuring things out",
    "Leadership — helping lead a group",
    "Helping others / kindness",
    "Being reliable — people can count on me",
    "Staying organized",
    "Being respectful",
    "Following safety rules",
    "Honesty / trustworthiness",
    "Persistence — not giving up when something is hard",
    "Finishing what I start",
    "Flexibility — adjusting when plans change",
    "Asking good questions",
    "Creativity — coming up with new ideas",
    "Empathy — understanding how others feel",
    "Working independently — getting things done without being told",
  ];

  // ── HTML Safety Helpers ───────────────────────────────────
  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return String(str || '')
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
      .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }
  function escapeAttr(str) {
    return String(str || '').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
  }

  // ── Default State ─────────────────────────────────────────
  function getDefaultState() {

    return {
      studentName: '',
      currentModule: 'welcome',

      // Module 1: Self-Knowledge
      personalInterests: [],
      academicInterests: [],
      abilities: [],
      workPreference: '', // 'people', 'ideas', 'things'
      growth: [], // array of {area, action} objects

      // Module 2: Career Exploration
      schoolExperiences: [],
      workExperiences: [],
      careersOfInterest: { career: '', education: '', skills: '', workEnvironment: '' },

      // Module 3: Skills Assessment
      skills: {},
      culminatingAnswer: '',

      // Module 4: Goal Setting
      careerGoal: '',
      needToLearn: '',
      firstStep: '',
      completedSteps: 'No',
    };
  }

  // Initialize skills in default state
  function initSkillsState(state) {
    SKILLS.forEach((s) => {
      if (!state.skills[s.id]) {
        state.skills[s.id] = { rating: 0, choice: '', custom: '' };
      } else if (state.skills[s.id].proof !== undefined) {
        // migrate old proof field
        state.skills[s.id].choice = '__custom__';
        state.skills[s.id].custom = state.skills[s.id].proof || '';
        delete state.skills[s.id].proof;
      } else if (state.skills[s.id].choice === undefined) {
        state.skills[s.id].choice = '';
        state.skills[s.id].custom = '';
      }
    });
    return state;
  }

  // ── Storage (localStorage with in-memory fallback for sandboxed iframes) ────
  let _memStore = {};
  const _storage = (function() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('__test__', '1');
      localStorage.removeItem('__test__');
      return localStorage;
    } catch(e) {
      return {
        getItem: function(k){ return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(_memStore,k) ? _memStore[k] : null; },
        setItem: function(k,v){ _memStore[k] = String(v); },
        removeItem: function(k){ delete _memStore[k]; }
      };
    }
  })();

  function loadState() {
    try {
      const raw = _storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        return initSkillsState({ ...getDefaultState(), ...parsed });
      }
    } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
    return initSkillsState(getDefaultState());
  }

  function saveState() {
    try { _storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
  }

  // Debounced save
  let saveTimeout;
  function debouncedSave() {
    clearTimeout(saveTimeout);
    saveTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      saveState();
      updateProgress();
    }, 300);
  }

  // ── File Save/Load Functionality ──────────────────────────
  function downloadSaveFile() {
    try {
      const safeName = (state.studentName || 'Traveler').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_');
      const dataStr = "data:text/json;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(state, null, 2));
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = dataStr;
      a.download = safeName + '_Career_Map.json';
      a.style.display = 'none';
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      try { a.click(); } catch(e2) { window.open(dataStr, '_blank'); }
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      showGridToast('Journey saved to file!');
    } catch (e) {
      showGridToast('Download not supported here — use Copy Everything instead.');
    }
  }

  function handleFileUpload(event) {
    const file = event.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
        if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
          state = initSkillsState({ ...getDefaultState(), ...parsed });
          saveState();
          showGridToast('Journey loaded successfully!');
          setTimeout(function() {
            initWelcome(); initSelfKnowledge(); initCareerExploration();
            initSkillsAssessment(); initGoalSetting();
            navigateTo(state.currentModule || 'welcome');
          }, 500);
        } else {
          showGridToast('⚠ Invalid save file format.');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Error parsing save file:', err);
        showGridToast('⚠ Could not read this file. Is it a valid JSON save?');
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
    // Reset input so they can re-upload the same file if needed
    event.target.value = '';
  }

  // ── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  let state = loadState();

  // ── DOM References ────────────────────────────────────────
  const $ = (sel) => document.querySelector(sel);
  const $$ = (sel) => document.querySelectorAll(sel);

  // ── Navigation ────────────────────────────────────────────
  function navigateTo(moduleId) {
    state.currentModule = moduleId;
    saveState();

    // Hide all sections
    $$('.module-section, .export-section, .welcome-section').forEach((el) => {
      el.classList.remove('active');
    });

    // Show target
    const target = document.getElementById(`module-${moduleId}`);
    if (target) target.classList.add('active');

    // Update sidebar active state
    $$('.nav-item').forEach((item) => {
      item.classList.toggle('active', item.dataset.module === moduleId);
    });

    // If navigating to export, render it
    if (moduleId === 'export') {
      renderExport();
    }

    // Scroll to top
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });

    updateProgress();
  }

  // ── Progress Calculation ──────────────────────────────────
  function calculateProgress() {
    let filled = 0;
    let total = 0;

    // Module 1: 3 personal + 3 academic + 2 abilities + 1 work preference + 2 growth = 11
    total += 3;
    filled += Math.min(state.personalInterests.length, 3);
    total += 3;
    filled += Math.min(state.academicInterests.length, 3);
    total += 2;
    filled += Math.min(state.abilities.length, 2);
    total += 1;
    if (state.workPreference) filled++;
    total += 2;
    filled += Math.min(state.growth.length, 2);

    // Module 2: at least 1 school experience + 1 work experience with content = 2 fields
    const hasSchool = state.schoolExperiences.some((e) => e.what.trim() || e.skill.trim());
    const hasWork = state.workExperiences.some((e) => e.what.trim() || e.skill.trim());
    total += 2;
    if (hasSchool) filled++;
    if (hasWork) filled++;

    // Module 3: 8 skills (rating + experience required) + culminating
    SKILLS.forEach((s) => {
      total += 1;
      const sk = state.skills[s.id] || {};
      const hasExp = sk.choice === '__custom__' ? !!(sk.custom || '').trim() : !!(sk.choice || '').trim();
      if (sk.rating > 0 && hasExp) filled++;
    });
    total += 1;
    if ((state.culminatingAnswer || '').trim()) filled++;

    // Module 4: 3 fields
    total += 3;
    if (state.careerGoal.trim()) filled++;
    if (state.needToLearn.trim()) filled++;
    if (state.firstStep.trim()) filled++;

    return total > 0 ? Math.round((filled / total) * 100) : 0;
  }

  function updateProgress() {
    const pct = calculateProgress();
    const ring = $('.progress-ring-fill');
    const label = $('.progress-percent');

    if (ring) {
      const circumference = 251.2;
      ring.style.strokeDashoffset = circumference - (pct / 100) * circumference;
    }
    if (label) {
      label.textContent = pct + '%';
    }

    // Update nav checkmarks
    updateNavChecks();
  }

  function updateNavChecks() {
    // Module 1 complete?
    const m1 =
      state.personalInterests.length >= 3 &&
      state.academicInterests.length >= 3 &&
      state.abilities.length >= 1 &&
      state.workPreference !== '' &&
      state.growth.length >= 2;
    toggleCheck('self-knowledge', m1);

    // Module 2 complete?
    const m2 =
      state.schoolExperiences.some((e) => e.what.trim() && e.skill.trim()) &&
      state.workExperiences.some((e) => e.what.trim() && e.skill.trim());
    toggleCheck('career-exploration', m2);

    // Module 3 complete?
    const m3 = SKILLS.every((s) => {
      const sk = state.skills[s.id] || {};
      const hasExp = sk.choice === '__custom__' ? !!(sk.custom || '').trim() : !!(sk.choice || '').trim();
      return sk.rating > 0 && hasExp;
    }) && !!(state.culminatingAnswer || '').trim();
    toggleCheck('skills-assessment', m3);

    // Module 4 complete?
    const m4 = state.careerGoal.trim() && state.needToLearn.trim() && state.firstStep.trim();
    toggleCheck('goal-setting', m4);
  }

  function toggleCheck(moduleId, complete) {
    const item = $(`.nav-item[data-module="${moduleId}"] .nav-check`);
    if (item) item.classList.toggle('visible', complete);
  }

  // ── Toast Notification ────────────────────────────────────
  function showGridToast(msg) {
    const t = $('#grid-toast');
    if (t) {
      t.textContent = msg;
      t.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 2500);
    }
  }

  function bindGridSelection(containerId, stateKey, maxSelect, updateCallback) {
    const container = $(`#${containerId}`);
    if (!container) return;

    // Load initial state into DOM
    state[stateKey].forEach(val => {
      let btn = container.querySelector(`[data-value="${val}"]`);
      if (!btn) {
        // Custom addition
        const isInterest = containerId === 'interest-container';
        const isSkill = containerId === 'skill-container';
        
        if (isSkill) {
          btn = document.createElement('div');
          btn.className = 'skill-card selected';
          btn.innerHTML = `<div class="skill-name"><span>✨</span> ${val}</div><div class="skill-desc">Custom Superpower</div>`;
          container.querySelector('.skill-grid')?.prepend(btn);
        } else {
          btn = document.createElement('button');
          if (isInterest) {
            btn.className = 'tag selected';
            btn.innerHTML = `✨ ${val}`;
            container.querySelector('.interest-tags')?.prepend(btn);
          } else {
            btn.className = 'class-btn selected';
            btn.innerHTML = `<span class="emoji">✨</span><span>${val}</span>`;
            container.prepend(btn); // Class grid directly
          }
        }
        btn.setAttribute('data-value', val);
      } else {
        btn.classList.add('selected');
      }
    });

    // Handle string array toggle
    container.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const item = e.target.closest('.tag, .class-btn, .skill-card');
      if (!item) return;

      const val = item.getAttribute('data-value');
      
      if (state[stateKey].includes(val)) {
        state[stateKey] = state[stateKey].filter(v => v !== val);
        item.classList.remove('selected');
      } else {
        if (state[stateKey].length >= maxSelect) {
          showGridToast(`Limit reached: You can only select ${maxSelect}!`);
          return;
        }
        state[stateKey].push(val);
        item.classList.add('selected');
      }
      updateCallback();
      debouncedSave();
    });
  }

  function bindCustomInput(inputId, btnId, containerId, stateKey, maxSelect, updateCallback) {
    const input = $(`#${inputId}`);
    const btn = $(`#${btnId}`);
    const container = $(`#${containerId}`);
    
    if (input && btn && container) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const val = input.value.trim();
        if (val) {
          if (state[stateKey].length >= maxSelect) {
            showGridToast(`Limit reached: You can only select ${maxSelect}!`);
            return;
          }
          if (state[stateKey].includes(val)) return;
          
          state[stateKey].push(val);
          input.value = '';
          
          let newEl;
          if (containerId === 'skill-container') {
             newEl = document.createElement('div');
             newEl.className = 'skill-card selected';
             newEl.innerHTML = `<div class="skill-name"><span>✨</span> ${val}</div><div class="skill-desc">Custom Superpower</div>`;
             container.querySelector('.skill-grid')?.prepend(newEl);
          } else {
             newEl = document.createElement('button');
             if (containerId === 'interest-container') {
               newEl.className = 'tag selected';
               newEl.innerHTML = `✨ ${val}`;
               container.querySelector('.interest-tags')?.prepend(newEl);
             } else {
               newEl.className = 'class-btn selected';
               newEl.innerHTML = `<span class="emoji">✨</span><span>${val}</span>`;
               container.prepend(newEl);
             }
          }
          newEl.setAttribute('data-value', val);
          
          updateCallback();
          debouncedSave();
        }
      });
    }
  }

  // Counter UI updaters
  function updateInterestCounter() {
    const c = state.personalInterests.length;
    const el = $('#interest-counter');
    if (el) {
      el.textContent = `Select 3 Interest Orbs to continue (${c}/3)`;
      el.classList.toggle('locked', c === 3);
    }
  }

  function updateClassCounter() {
    const c = state.academicInterests.length;
    const el = $('#class-counter');
    if (el) {
      el.textContent = c === 3 ? "Top 3 Subjects Locked! ✨" : `Select 3 Favorite Subjects (${c}/3)`;
      el.classList.toggle('locked', c === 3);
    }
  }

  function updateSkillCounter() {
    const c = state.abilities.length;
    const el = $('#skill-counter');
    if (el) {
      el.textContent = `Identify 1-2 Natural Superpowers (${c}/2)`;
      el.classList.toggle('locked', c > 0);
    }
  }

  // ── Module 1: Self-Knowledge ──────────────────────────────
  function initSelfKnowledge() {
    bindGridSelection('interest-container', 'personalInterests', 3, updateInterestCounter);
    bindGridSelection('class-container', 'academicInterests', 3, updateClassCounter);
    bindGridSelection('skill-container', 'abilities', 2, updateSkillCounter);
    bindCustomInput('custom-interest-in', 'add-interest-btn', 'interest-container', 'personalInterests', 3, updateInterestCounter);
    bindCustomInput('custom-class-in', 'add-class-btn', 'class-container', 'academicInterests', 3, updateClassCounter);
    bindCustomInput('custom-skill-in', 'add-skill-btn', 'skill-container', 'abilities', 2, updateSkillCounter);
    updateInterestCounter();
    updateClassCounter();
    updateSkillCounter();
    initGrowth();

    // Work path cards (replaces radio buttons)
    $$('#work-pref-container .work-path-card').forEach((card) => {
      if (card.dataset.value === state.workPreference) card.classList.add('selected');
      card.addEventListener('click', () => {
        $$('#work-pref-container .work-path-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
        card.classList.add('selected');
        state.workPreference = card.dataset.value;
        debouncedSave();
        updateProgress();
      });
    });
  }

  // ── Growth & Fortification ────────────────────────────────
  function initGrowth() {
    // Restore saved state into DOM
    state.growth.forEach(({ area, action }) => {
      const card = $(`#grow-container .grow-card[data-value="${CSS.escape(area)}"]`);
      if (card) {
        card.classList.add('grow-selected');
        const input = card.querySelector('.action-input');
        if (input) input.value = action || '';
      }
    });
    updateGrowCounter();

    // Bind click-to-reveal for each grow card
    $$('.grow-card').forEach((card) => {
      card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target.tagName.toLowerCase() === 'input') return;
        const val = card.dataset.value;
        const input = card.querySelector('.action-input');

        if (card.classList.contains('grow-selected')) {
          // Deselect
          card.classList.remove('grow-selected');
          state.growth = state.growth.filter(g => g.area !== val);
        } else {
          if (state.growth.length >= 3) {
            showGridToast('⚠ Limit reached! Max 3 areas to strengthen.');
            return;
          }
          card.classList.add('grow-selected');
          state.growth.push({ area: val, action: input ? input.value : '' });
          if (input) setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 50);
        }
        updateGrowCounter();
        debouncedSave();
      });

      // Update state when typing in action input
      const input = card.querySelector('.action-input');
      if (input) {
        input.addEventListener('input', () => {
          const val = card.dataset.value;
          const entry = state.growth.find(g => g.area === val);
          if (entry) {
            entry.action = input.value;
            debouncedSave();
          }
        });
      }
    });
  }

  function updateGrowCounter() {
    const c = state.growth.length;
    const el = $('#grow-counter');
    if (el) el.textContent = `Select 2–3 Areas to Strengthen (${c}/3)`;
    updateProgress();
  }

  // ── Module 2: Career Exploration ──────────────────────────
  function initCareerExploration() {
    initExpTiles('school');
    initExpTiles('work');
    initCareersOfInterest();
  }

  function initCareersOfInterest() {
    // Make sure state object exists (handle older saves that lacked it)
    if (!state.careersOfInterest || typeof state.careersOfInterest !== 'object') {
      state.careersOfInterest = { career: '', education: '', skills: '', workEnvironment: '' };
    }
    const map = [
      { id: 'career-coi-name',        key: 'career' },
      { id: 'career-coi-education',   key: 'education' },
      { id: 'career-coi-skills',      key: 'skills' },
      { id: 'career-coi-environment', key: 'workEnvironment' },
    ];
    map.forEach(({ id, key }) => {
      const el = $('#' + id);
      if (!el) return;
      el.value = state.careersOfInterest[key] || '';
      el.addEventListener('input', () => {
        state.careersOfInterest[key] = el.value;
        debouncedSave();
        updateProgress();
      });
    });

    // Wire up tutorial toggles for this section
    bindTutorialToggles();

    // Personalized tip for "Skills I Need to Acquire" — pull from user's abilities (Quest I)
    const skillsTip = $('#coi-skills-tip');
    const skillsTipText = $('#coi-skills-tip-text');
    if (skillsTip && skillsTipText && Array.isArray(state.abilities)) {
      const myAbilities = state.abilities.filter(a => a && a.trim());
      if (myAbilities.length) {
        skillsTipText.textContent = `You said your strengths include "${myAbilities.slice(0, 3).join('", "')}". Does the career you researched also need any of these? If so, write that.`;
        skillsTip.style.display = 'block';
      }
    }
  }

  // Tutorial toggle handler — opens/closes the "Help me think through this" panel.
  // Idempotent: safe to call multiple times because we mark bound buttons.
  function bindTutorialToggles() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tutorial-toggle').forEach((btn) => {
      if (btn.dataset.bound === '1') return;
      btn.dataset.bound = '1';
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const targetId = btn.dataset.toggle;
        const panel = document.getElementById(targetId);
        if (!panel) return;
        const isOpen = panel.classList.toggle('open');
        btn.classList.toggle('open', isOpen);
        const chev = btn.querySelector('.chev');
        if (chev) chev.textContent = isOpen ? '▲' : '▼';
        // Update text
        const labelNode = btn.childNodes[0];
        if (labelNode && labelNode.nodeType === 3) {
          labelNode.textContent = isOpen ? '💡 Hide help ' : '💡 Help me think through this ';
        }
      });
    });

    // Examples toggle — same pattern, different label/icon
    document.querySelectorAll('.examples-toggle').forEach((btn) => {
      if (btn.dataset.bound === '1') return;
      btn.dataset.bound = '1';
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const targetId = btn.dataset.toggleExamples;
        const panel = document.getElementById(targetId);
        if (!panel) return;
        const isOpen = panel.classList.toggle('open');
        btn.classList.toggle('open', isOpen);
        const chev = btn.querySelector('.chev');
        if (chev) chev.textContent = isOpen ? '▲' : '▼';
        const labelNode = btn.childNodes[0];
        if (labelNode && labelNode.nodeType === 3) {
          labelNode.textContent = isOpen ? '📚 Hide examples ' : '📚 Show examples ';
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function initExpTiles(type) {
    const tilesGrid = $(`#${type}-tiles`);
    const formsContainer = $(`#${type}-experience-forms`);
    if (!tilesGrid || !formsContainer) return;

    // Restore any saved experiences as open form panels
    const list = type === 'school' ? state.schoolExperiences : state.workExperiences;
    list.forEach((exp, idx) => {
      if (exp.what || exp.skill) {
        // Find matching tile and mark open
        const matchTile = tilesGrid.querySelector(`[data-prompt="${exp.prompt || ''}"]`);
        if (matchTile) matchTile.classList.add('open');
        formsContainer.appendChild(buildExpForm(type, exp.prompt || exp.what, idx, exp));
      }
    });

    // Bind tile clicks
    tilesGrid.querySelectorAll('.exp-tile').forEach((tile) => {
      tile.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (tile.classList.contains('open')) {
          // Close: remove the matching form panel
          tile.classList.remove('open');
          const existing = formsContainer.querySelector(`[data-tile-prompt="${tile.dataset.prompt}"]`);
          if (existing) existing.remove();
          // Remove from state
          const arr = type === 'school' ? state.schoolExperiences : state.workExperiences;
          const filtered = arr.filter(e => e.prompt !== tile.dataset.prompt);
          if (type === 'school') state.schoolExperiences = filtered;
          else state.workExperiences = filtered;
          debouncedSave();
          return;
        }
        tile.classList.add('open');
        const newEntry = { prompt: tile.dataset.prompt, what: '', skill: '' };
        const arr = type === 'school' ? state.schoolExperiences : state.workExperiences;
        arr.push(newEntry);
        const idx = arr.length - 1;
        const panel = buildExpForm(type, tile.dataset.prompt, idx, newEntry);
        formsContainer.appendChild(panel);
        panel.querySelector('input, textarea').focus();
        debouncedSave();
      });
    });
  }

  function buildExpForm(type, prompt, idx, data) {
    const panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.className = 'exp-tile-inputs visible';
    panel.dataset.tilePrompt = prompt;
    const arr = type === 'school' ? state.schoolExperiences : state.workExperiences;
    const whatLabel = type === 'school' ? 'What did you do or where did you go?' : 'What did you do?';
    const skillLabel = 'What skill did you learn or use?';

    // Build dropdown options for the soft-skills list
    const currentSkill = data.skill || '';
    const skillOptsHtml = SOFT_SKILLS.map((s) => {
      const sel = currentSkill === s ? ' selected' : '';
      return `<option value="${escapeAttr(s)}"${sel}>${escapeHtml(s)}</option>`;
    }).join('');

    panel.innerHTML = `
      <div class="form-label" style="font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-primary); margin-bottom:8px;">📌 ${escapeHtml(prompt)}</div>
      <label class="form-label">${whatLabel}</label>
      <input type="text" class="form-input exp-what-input" placeholder="e.g., ${expPlaceholder(type, prompt)}" value="${escapeAttr(data.what || '')}">
      <label class="form-label" style="margin-top:8px;">${skillLabel}</label>
      <select class="form-input exp-skill-select" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:0.9rem;">
        <option value="">— pick a skill that fits best —</option>
        ${skillOptsHtml}
      </select>
      <button class="tile-close-btn">✕ Remove this entry</button>
    `;
    const whatInput = panel.querySelector('.exp-what-input');
    const skillSelect = panel.querySelector('.exp-skill-select');
    whatInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
      const entry = arr[idx];
      if (entry) { entry.what = whatInput.value; debouncedSave(); updateProgress(); }
    });
    skillSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const entry = arr[idx];
      if (entry) { entry.skill = skillSelect.value; debouncedSave(); updateProgress(); }
    });
    panel.querySelector('.tile-close-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      // Find the tile and un-mark it
      const tile = $(`#${type}-tiles [data-prompt="${prompt}"]`);
      if (tile) tile.classList.remove('open');
      arr.splice(idx, 1);
      panel.remove();
      debouncedSave();
      updateProgress();
    });
    return panel;
  }

  function expPlaceholder(type, prompt) {
    const map = {
      'School I Attended': 'Lincoln Elementary School',
      'Club or Sport': 'Art club, soccer team, coding club',
      'School Event': 'Science fair, talent show',
      'Community or Volunteer': 'Food drive, scouting',
      'Program or Camp': 'Summer math camp, library reading program',
      'Student Leadership': 'Class representative, student council',
      'Chores at Home': 'Dishes, laundry, cooking dinner',
      'Helping with Pets': 'Walking neighbor\'s dog on weekends',
      'Helping Younger Kids': 'Reading to my little sister',
      'Helping Family': 'Working at the family store on weekends',
      'My Own Project': 'Lemonade stand, selling bracelets',
      'Helping Neighbors': 'Carrying groceries, shoveling snow',
    };
    return map[prompt] || 'Describe your experience...';
  }

  function renderExperienceList(type, list) {
    const container = $(`#${type}-experience-list`);
    if (!container) return;

    container.innerHTML = '';
    list.forEach((exp, index) => {
      container.appendChild(createExperienceCard(type, index, exp));
    });
  }

  function createExperienceCard(type, index, data) {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'experience-card';

    const whatPlaceholder = type === 'school'
      ? 'e.g., I went to Lincoln Elementary School, I joined the art club in 6th grade, I volunteered at the school book fair...'
      : 'e.g., I do the dishes and take out the trash at home, I walk my neighbor\'s dog on weekends, I helped my mom organize her office...';

    const skillPlaceholder = type === 'school'
      ? 'e.g., I learned how to work with a team, I got better at public speaking, I learned to be responsible...'
      : 'e.g., I learned to be responsible, I got better at managing my time, I learned how to follow instructions...';

    card.innerHTML = `
      <button class="remove-btn" aria-label="Remove experience" title="Remove">✕</button>
      <div class="experience-fields">
        <div class="form-group">
          <label class="form-label">What did you do?</label>
          <textarea class="form-textarea exp-what" placeholder="${whatPlaceholder}" rows="2">${data.what || ''}</textarea>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label class="form-label">What skill did you get from it?</label>
          <textarea class="form-textarea exp-skill" placeholder="${skillPlaceholder}" rows="2">${data.skill || ''}</textarea>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    const stateList = type === 'school' ? state.schoolExperiences : state.workExperiences;

    card.querySelector('.exp-what').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      stateList[index].what = e.target.value;
      debouncedSave();
    });

    card.querySelector('.exp-skill').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      stateList[index].skill = e.target.value;
      debouncedSave();
    });

    card.querySelector('.remove-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (stateList.length <= 1) return; // Keep at least one
      stateList.splice(index, 1);
      renderExperienceList(type, stateList);
      debouncedSave();
    });

    return card;
  }

  function addExperience(type) {
    const stateList = type === 'school' ? state.schoolExperiences : state.workExperiences;
    stateList.push({ what: '', skill: '' });
    renderExperienceList(type, stateList);
    debouncedSave();
  }

  // ── Module 3: Skills Assessment ───────────────────────────
  function initSkillsAssessment() {
    const container = $('#skills-container');
    if (!container) return;

    container.innerHTML = '';
    SKILLS.forEach((skill) => {
      container.appendChild(createSkillBlock(skill));
    });

    // Bind culminating activity
    const culmEl = $('#culminating-answer');
    if (culmEl) {
      culmEl.value = state.culminatingAnswer || '';
      culmEl.addEventListener('input', () => {
        state.culminatingAnswer = culmEl.value;
        debouncedSave();
        updateProgress();
      });
    }
  }

  function createSkillBlock(skill) {
    const block = document.createElement('div');
    block.className = 'skill-block';

    const currentRating = state.skills[skill.id]?.rating || 0;
    const currentChoice = state.skills[skill.id]?.choice || '';
    const currentCustom = state.skills[skill.id]?.custom || '';

    let starsHtml = '';
    for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
      const locked = i > 3;
      starsHtml += locked
        ? `<button class="star-btn star-locked" data-value="${i}" aria-label="Locked — available in Grade 12" disabled title="You'll unlock this rating in Grade 12!">✦</button>`
        : `<button class="star-btn ${i <= currentRating ? 'active' : ''}" data-value="${i}" aria-label="Rate ${i} out of 5">✦</button>`;
    }

    const optsHtml = (skill.examples || []).map(e => {
      const esc = e.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
      const sel = currentChoice === e ? ' selected' : '';
      return `<option value="${esc}"${sel}>${esc}</option>`;
    }).join('');

    const showCustom = currentChoice === '__custom__';
    const customEsc = currentCustom.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');

    block.innerHTML = `
      <div class="skill-name">${skill.name}
        <span style="font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--accent-secondary);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;margin-left:8px;">${skill.officialName}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-desc">${skill.desc}</div>
      <div class="skill-slider-row">
        <span class="skill-slider-label">My Level:</span>
        <div class="star-rating" data-skill-id="${skill.id}">
          ${starsHtml}
        </div>
        <span class="skill-value">${currentRating > 0 ? currentRating + '/5' : '—'}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="proof-box" style="margin-top:var(--space-md);">
        <label class="form-label">
          <span style="color:var(--accent-secondary);">📋</span>
          Choose an experience that shows this skill
          <span class="proof-required">*</span>
        </label>
        <select class="form-input skill-exp-select" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--text-primary);">
          <option value="">— pick one that fits you —</option>
          ${optsHtml}
          <option value="__custom__"${showCustom ? ' selected' : ''}>✏️ Write my own…</option>
        </select>
        <div class="skill-custom-wrap" style="display:${showCustom ? 'block' : 'none'};margin-top:var(--space-sm);">
          <input type="text" class="form-input skill-custom-input"
            placeholder="Describe your own experience here…"
            value="${customEsc}"
            style="font-size:0.85rem;" />
        </div>
        <p style="font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:6px;font-style:italic;">Most 6th graders pick 1 or 2 — be honest! ⭐⭐⭐ is the max right now. You'll unlock ⭐⭐⭐⭐ and ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ when you're a senior.</p>
        <p style="font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:3px;font-style:italic;">🔒 Final Skill Level column stays as — until Grade 12.</p>
      </div>
    `;

    // Star clicks (max 3 in 6th grade; 4-5 unlocked in Grade 12)
    block.querySelectorAll('.star-btn:not(.star-locked)').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const value = parseInt(btn.dataset.value);
        state.skills[skill.id].rating = value;
        block.querySelectorAll('.star-btn').forEach((b) => {
          b.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(b.dataset.value) <= value);
        });
        block.querySelector('.skill-value').textContent = value + '/5';
        debouncedSave();
        updateProgress();
      });
    });

    // Dropdown change
    const sel = block.querySelector('.skill-exp-select');
    const customWrap = block.querySelector('.skill-custom-wrap');
    const customIn = block.querySelector('.skill-custom-input');
    sel.addEventListener('change', () => {
      state.skills[skill.id].choice = sel.value;
      customWrap.style.display = sel.value === '__custom__' ? 'block' : 'none';
      if (sel.value !== '__custom__') { state.skills[skill.id].custom = ''; }
      debouncedSave();
      updateProgress();
    });
    if (customIn) {
      customIn.addEventListener('input', () => {
        state.skills[skill.id].custom = customIn.value;
        debouncedSave();
      });
    }

    return block;
  }

  // ── Module 4: Goal Setting ────────────────────────────────
  function initGoalSetting() {
    const fields = [
      { id: 'career-goal', key: 'careerGoal' },
      { id: 'need-to-learn', key: 'needToLearn' },
      { id: 'first-step', key: 'firstStep' },
    ];

    fields.forEach(({ id, key }) => {
      const el = $(`#${id}`);
      if (el) {
        el.value = state[key] || '';
        el.addEventListener('input', () => {
          state[key] = el.value;
          debouncedSave();
        });
      }
    });

    // Completed Steps dropdown (Yes/No)
    const completedEl = $('#completed-steps');
    if (completedEl) {
      completedEl.value = state.completedSteps || 'No';
      completedEl.addEventListener('change', () => {
        state.completedSteps = completedEl.value;
        debouncedSave();
        updateProgress();
      });
    }

    // Wire tutorial toggles for goal-setting cards
    bindTutorialToggles();

    // Personalized tips — light personalization referencing earlier answers
    populateGoalTips();
  }

  // Populate the green "from your earlier answers" tip boxes when user has data.
  // Looks at state.careersOfInterest, state.academicInterests, state.personalInterests.
  function populateGoalTips() {
    const coiCareer = (state.careersOfInterest && state.careersOfInterest.career || '').trim();

    // Tip for "Goals" — if they've named a career, reference it
    const goalTip = $('#goal-tip');
    const goalTipText = $('#goal-tip-text');
    if (goalTip && goalTipText && coiCareer) {
      goalTipText.textContent = `You researched "${coiCareer}". Your goal could be about getting closer to that career — or learning more about it before deciding.`;
      goalTip.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // Tip for "Education Plans" — pull from academic interests + COI
    const eduTip = $('#edu-tip');
    const eduTipText = $('#edu-tip-text');
    if (eduTip && eduTipText) {
      const myClasses = (state.academicInterests || []).filter(c => c && c.trim());
      if (myClasses.length || coiCareer) {
        const parts = [];
        if (myClasses.length) {
          parts.push(`You said your favorite classes include "${myClasses.slice(0, 3).join('", "')}".`);
        }
        if (coiCareer) {
          parts.push(`Think about which of those classes connect to "${coiCareer}".`);
        }
        eduTipText.textContent = parts.join(' ');
        eduTip.style.display = 'block';
      }
    }

    // Tip for "Action Steps" — pull from personal interests (hobbies)
    const actionTip = $('#action-tip');
    const actionTipText = $('#action-tip-text');
    if (actionTip && actionTipText) {
      const myHobbies = (state.personalInterests || []).filter(h => h && h.trim());
      if (myHobbies.length) {
        actionTipText.textContent = `You listed "${myHobbies.slice(0, 3).join('", "')}" as things you enjoy. Could one of these become an action step that connects to your career goal?`;
        actionTip.style.display = 'block';
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Export / Quest Log ────────────────────────────────────
  function renderExport() {
    const container = $('#export-content');
    if (!container) return;

    const name = state.studentName || 'Traveler';

    let html = `
      <div class="export-header-bar">
        <div>
          <div class="module-number">Your Quest Log</div>
          <div class="module-title" style="font-size:1.3rem;">${escapeHtml(name)}'s Career Map</div>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <button class="copy-all-btn" id="download-pdf-btn" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ec4899,#be185d);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(236,72,153,0.35);">📑 Download PDF (for Google Classroom)</button>
          <button class="copy-all-btn" id="download-txt-btn" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#2563eb);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(59,130,246,0.35);">📄 Download .txt</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="site-hint" style="display:block;">
        <div style="font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent-primary);margin-bottom:10px;">📜 How to Finish Your Career Map</div>
        <div style="background:#fce7f3;border-left:4px solid #ec4899;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:14px;border-radius:4px;">
          <div style="font-weight:700;color:#be185d;margin-bottom:4px;">📑 To turn in on Google Classroom:</div>
          <div style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#831843;">Click <strong>"📑 Download PDF"</strong> above. When the print window opens, choose <strong>"Save as PDF"</strong> as the destination, then click Save. Upload that PDF to Google Classroom.</div>
        </div>
        <div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;">📋 To copy your answers into MaiaLearning — 4 Steps:</div>
        <ol style="margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.8;font-size:0.92rem;">
          <li>In another tab, log in to your school portal and open <strong>MaiaLearning → Careers → Career Plan → New York State Career Plan</strong>.</li>
          <li>Put the two tabs <strong>side by side</strong> — this Quest Log on one side, MaiaLearning on the other. The boxes line up: Section A goes with Section A, Section B with Section B, and so on.</li>
          <li>For each box below, click the <strong>📋 Copy</strong> button next to your answer, then click into the matching MaiaLearning box and paste (Ctrl+V or ⌘+V).</li>
          <li>Watch out for <strong style="color:#dc2626;">⚠ Empty</strong> boxes below — those mean you missed something. Click the link inside to jump back and fix it.</li>
        </ol>
      </div>
    `;

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // SECTION A — Self-Knowledge: Who Am I?
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    html += `
      <div class="form-mirror-section">
        <div class="form-mirror-tab">Knowledge</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-header">A. Self Knowledge: Who am I?</div>

        <!-- Interests row -->
        <div class="form-mirror-desc">Interests : List your top three choices for each of the following areas of interest</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-columns">
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:0 0 60px;">Grade</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">1a. Personal : Out-of-school Activities you Enjoy</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">1b. Academic : Classes or subjects you Enjoy the Most</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">1c. Work Preference : Working with People, Ideas, and Things</div>
        </div>
    `;

    // Render rows for each interest entry (just one row combining all 3)
    const ordinals = ['1st', '2nd', '3rd'];
    const formatTopThree = (arr) => arr
      .filter(v => v.trim())
      .map((v, i) => `${ordinals[i] || (i+1)+'th'}: ${v}`)
      .join('\n');
    html += `
        <div class="form-mirror-row">
          <div class="form-mirror-grade">6</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(formatTopThree(state.personalInterests), 'Out-of-school Activities', 'self-knowledge')}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(formatTopThree(state.academicInterests), 'Classes/Subjects', 'self-knowledge')}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(formatPreference(state.workPreference), 'Work Preference', 'self-knowledge')}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    // Abilities Row
    html += `
      <div class="form-mirror-section" style="margin-top:20px;">
        <div class="form-mirror-desc">1d. Abilities : Identify your abilities</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-columns">
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:0 0 60px;">Grade</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Abilities</div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-mirror-row">
          <div class="form-mirror-grade">6</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(state.abilities.filter(v => v.trim()).join(', '), 'Abilities', 'self-knowledge')}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;


    // Growth Row (1e. Areas to Strengthen)
    html += `
      <div class="form-mirror-section" style="margin-top:20px;">
        <div class="form-mirror-desc">1e. Personal and academic areas I need to strengthen</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-columns">
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:0 0 60px;">Grade</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Areas I Need to Strengthen</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Steps I Will Take to Strengthen These Areas</div>
        </div>
        ${state.growth.length ? state.growth.map(g => `
        <div class="form-mirror-row">
          <div class="form-mirror-grade">6</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">${formMirrorField(g.area, 'Area to Strengthen', 'self-knowledge')}</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">${formMirrorField(g.action || '', 'Action Step', 'self-knowledge')}</div>
        </div>`).join('') : `
        <div class="form-mirror-row">
          <div class="form-mirror-grade">6</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">${formMirrorField('', 'Areas to Strengthen', 'self-knowledge')}</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">${formMirrorField('', 'Action Steps', 'self-knowledge')}</div>
        </div>`}
      </div>
    `;

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // SECTION B — Career Exploration: Where Am I Going?
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    html += `
      <div class="form-mirror-section">
        <div class="form-mirror-header">B. Career Exploration: Where am I going?</div>

        <!-- School/Community Experiences -->
        <div class="form-mirror-desc">Schools and/or Community Experiences : I have participated in the following school and/or community experiences</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-columns">
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:0 0 60px;">Grade</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">School and/or Community Experiences</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Skills Acquired Through Experiences</div>
        </div>
    `;

    state.schoolExperiences.forEach((exp) => {
      if (exp.what.trim() || exp.skill.trim()) {
        html += `
        <div class="form-mirror-row">
          <div class="form-mirror-grade">6</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(exp.what, 'School/Community Experiences', 'career-exploration')}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(exp.skill, 'Skills Acquired Through Experiences', 'career-exploration')}
          </div>
        </div>`;
      }
    });

    // Work Experiences
    html += `
        <div class="form-mirror-desc" style="margin-top:var(--space-xl);">Work Experiences : I have participated in the following work experiences</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-columns">
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:0 0 60px;">Grade</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Work Experiences</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Skills Acquired Through Work Experience</div>
        </div>
    `;

    state.workExperiences.forEach((exp) => {
      if (exp.what.trim() || exp.skill.trim()) {
        html += `
        <div class="form-mirror-row">
          <div class="form-mirror-grade">6</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(exp.what, 'Work Experiences', 'career-exploration')}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(exp.skill, 'Skills Acquired Through Work Experience', 'career-exploration')}
          </div>
        </div>`;
      }
    });

    // Careers of Interest & Characteristics
    const coi = state.careersOfInterest || { career: '', education: '', skills: '', workEnvironment: '' };
    html += `
        <div class="form-mirror-desc" style="margin-top:var(--space-xl);">Careers of Interest and Characteristics : I am interested in the following careers and have discovered the following information about these careers</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-columns">
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:0 0 60px;">Grade</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Careers of Interest</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Education Requirements</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Skills I Need to Acquire</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Work Environment</div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-mirror-row">
          <div class="form-mirror-grade">6</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(coi.career, 'Careers of Interest', 'career-exploration')}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(coi.education, 'Education Requirements', 'career-exploration')}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(coi.skills, 'Skills I Need to Acquire', 'career-exploration')}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(coi.workEnvironment, 'Work Environment', 'career-exploration')}
          </div>
        </div>
    `;

    html += `</div>`;

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // SECTION C — Future Goals & Decision Making
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    html += `
      <div class="form-mirror-section">
        <div class="form-mirror-header">C. Future Goals and Decision Making : How do I get there?</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-desc">Career Goals and Action Steps</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-columns">
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:0 0 60px;">Grade</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Goals (resulting from career exploration activities)</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Education Plans (courses that relate to my career interests)</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Action Steps (What I need to do to accomplish my goals)</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:0 0 110px;">Completed Steps</div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-mirror-row">
          <div class="form-mirror-grade">6</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(state.careerGoal, 'Goals', 'goal-setting')}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(state.needToLearn, 'Education Plans', 'goal-setting')}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(state.firstStep, 'Action Steps', 'goal-setting')}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell" style="flex:0 0 110px;">
            <div class="form-mirror-grade" style="flex:1;width:100%;">${escapeHtml(state.completedSteps || 'No')}</div>
            <div style="font-size:0.7rem;color:#64748b;margin-top:6px;text-align:center;">Pick this one in MaiaLearning's dropdown</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // SECTION — Skills/Application
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    html += `
      <div class="form-mirror-section">
        <div class="form-mirror-header">Skills/Application : What do I need to know? What skills are important to me?</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-desc">Directions: Identify for each skill the level of achievement you believe you possess. Briefly describe a classroom experience or an activity that helped you develop each skill.</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-columns">
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:2;">Skills</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:0 0 140px;">Beginning Skill Level I possess</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Experiences / Activities / Applications</div>
        </div>
    `;

    SKILLS.forEach((skill) => {
      const s = state.skills[skill.id] || {};
      const ratingText = s.rating > 0 ? `${s.rating} out of 5` : '';
      const expText = s.choice === '__custom__' ? (s.custom || '') : (s.choice || '');
      html += `
        <div class="form-mirror-row form-mirror-skill-row">
          <div class="form-mirror-cell" style="flex:2;">
            <div class="form-mirror-skill-name">${skill.officialName}: <span style="color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:400;">${skill.desc}</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell" style="flex:0 0 140px;">
            ${formMirrorField(ratingText, skill.officialName + ' — Level', 'skills-assessment')}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell" style="flex:1;">
            ${formMirrorField(expText, skill.officialName + ' — Experience', 'skills-assessment')}
          </div>
        </div>`;
    });

    html += `</div>`;

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // CULMINATING ACTIVITY — its own pink section
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    const culminatingActivityText = "In 6th grade home and careers we are doing a unit on careers where we are looking at my interests, my values, what environment I perform best in and what careers are available to start working toward.";
    html += `
      <div class="form-mirror-section form-mirror-section-pink">
        <div class="form-mirror-header form-mirror-header-pink">🎯 Culminating Activity</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-desc">Directions: Briefly describe the activity that you completed. Indicate the most important thing you learned about yourself through this activity. Describe how this self knowledge will influence your plans for the future.</div>
        <div class="form-mirror-columns">
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Activity</div>
          <div class="form-mirror-col-header" style="flex:1;">Self Knowledge / Future Plans</div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-mirror-row">
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(culminatingActivityText, 'Activity', null)}
          </div>
          <div class="form-mirror-cell">
            ${formMirrorField(state.culminatingAnswer || '', 'Self Knowledge / Future Plans', 'skills-assessment')}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;



    container.innerHTML = html;

    // Bind all copy buttons
    container.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const text = btn.dataset.copyText;
        if (!text) return;
        copyToClipboard(text);
        btn.classList.add('copied');
        btn.innerHTML = '✓ Copied!';
        setTimeout(() => {
          btn.classList.remove('copied');
          btn.innerHTML = '📋 Copy';
        }, 1500);
      });
    });

    // Bind empty-warning "go back" buttons
    container.querySelectorAll('.empty-warning-btn').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const target = btn.dataset.goBack;
        if (target) navigateTo(target);
      });
    });

    // Download as .txt (plain text backup)
    const dlTxtBtn = $('#download-txt-btn');
    if (dlTxtBtn) {
      dlTxtBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const text = buildFullCopyText();
        const safeName = (state.studentName || 'Traveler').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_');
        const dataStr = "data:text/plain;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(text);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = dataStr;
        a.download = safeName + '_Career_Map.txt';
        a.style.display = 'none';
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        try { a.click(); } catch(e) { window.open(dataStr, '_blank'); }
        document.body.removeChild(a);
        showToast('Downloaded plain text version! 📄');
      });
    }

    // Download as PDF — opens the form-mirror HTML in a popup and triggers print dialog
    // Students choose "Save as PDF" as the destination. PDF is immune to Drive auto-conversion
    // when uploaded to Google Classroom.
    const dlPdfBtn = $('#download-pdf-btn');
    if (dlPdfBtn) {
      dlPdfBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const htmlDoc = buildFullCopyHTML();
        // Open a new window. Some popup blockers will block this if it's not from a click —
        // it IS from a click, so should be fine.
        const printWindow = window.open('', '_blank', 'width=900,height=1100');
        if (!printWindow) {
          showToast('⚠ Please allow pop-ups for this page, then try again.');
          return;
        }
        printWindow.document.open();
        printWindow.document.write(htmlDoc);
        printWindow.document.close();
        // Set the document title — this becomes the default PDF filename in most browsers
        const safeName = (state.studentName || 'Traveler').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_');
        printWindow.document.title = safeName + '_Career_Map';

        // Wait for the new window to finish parsing/loading before printing
        const triggerPrint = () => {
          try {
            printWindow.focus();
            printWindow.print();
          } catch (e) {
            // Fallback: tell student to use Ctrl/Cmd+P themselves
          }
        };
        // Use load event if available; fall back to short delay
        if (printWindow.document.readyState === 'complete') {
          setTimeout(triggerPrint, 300);
        } else {
          printWindow.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(triggerPrint, 300));
          // Failsafe in case load never fires
          setTimeout(triggerPrint, 1500);
        }
        showToast('When the print box opens, choose "Save as PDF" 📑');
      });
    }
  }

  // Maps "go back module" key → human-readable name shown in the empty warning
  const GO_BACK_LABELS = {
    'self-knowledge':       'Quest I: Who Am I?',
    'career-exploration':   'Quest II: Where Am I Going?',
    'skills-assessment':    'Quest III: My Skills',
    'goal-setting':         'Quest IV: My Goals',
  };

  function formMirrorField(value, copyLabel, goBackModule) {
    const displayValue = value && value.trim() ? value.trim() : '';
    const isEmpty = !displayValue;

    if (isEmpty) {
      const target = goBackModule && GO_BACK_LABELS[goBackModule];
      const warning = target
        ? `<button class="empty-warning-btn" data-go-back="${escapeAttr(goBackModule)}">⚠ Empty — click to fill in <strong>${escapeHtml(target)}</strong></button>`
        : `<div class="form-mirror-value" style="font-style:italic;color:#94a3b8;">(not filled in yet)</div>`;
      return `
        <div class="form-mirror-field empty">
          ${warning}
          <button class="copy-btn" data-copy-text="" title="Copy: ${escapeAttr(copyLabel)}" disabled>📋 Copy</button>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    return `
      <div class="form-mirror-field">
        <div class="form-mirror-value">${escapeHtml(displayValue)}</div>
        <button class="copy-btn" data-copy-text="${escapeAttr(displayValue)}" title="Copy: ${escapeAttr(copyLabel)}">📋 Copy</button>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function formatPreference(pref) {
    const labels = {
      people: 'Working with People (The Social Guild)',
      ideas:  'Working with Ideas (The Sage Circle)',
      things: 'Working with Things (The Forge Masters)',
    };
    return labels[pref] || '';
  }

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
  }

  function escapeAttr(str) {
    return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
  }

  function buildFullCopyText() {
    let lines = [];
    lines.push(`===== NYS CAREER MAP: ${state.studentName || 'Student'} =====`);
    lines.push('');

    lines.push('--- A. SELF-KNOWLEDGE: WHO AM I? ---');

    // 1a. Personal interests — all on one line, labelled 1st/2nd/3rd
    const ordinals = ['1st', '2nd', '3rd'];
    const personalStr = state.personalInterests.length
      ? state.personalInterests.map((v, i) => `${ordinals[i] || (i+1)+'th'}: ${v}`).join(', ')
      : '(blank)';
    lines.push(`1a. Personal : Out-of-school Activities you Enjoy: ${personalStr}`);

    // 1b. Academic interests — same format
    const academicStr = state.academicInterests.length
      ? state.academicInterests.map((v, i) => `${ordinals[i] || (i+1)+'th'}: ${v}`).join(', ')
      : '(blank)';
    lines.push(`1b. Academic : Classes or subjects you Enjoy the Most: ${academicStr}`);

    // 1c. Work preference
    const prefLabels = { people: 'Working with People — The Social Guild', ideas: 'Working with Ideas — The Sage Circle', things: 'Working with Things — The Forge Masters' };
    lines.push(`1c. Work Preference : Working with People, Ideas, or Things: ${prefLabels[state.workPreference] || '(blank)'}`);

    // 1d. Abilities with auto-generated career suggestions
    if (state.abilities.length) {
      const abilitiesStr = state.abilities.map(ab => {
        const careers = ABILITY_CAREERS[ab] || 'Various careers';
        return `${ab} | Careers where this would be useful: ${careers}`;
      }).join(' ←♦ ♦ ♦→ ');
      lines.push(`1d. Abilities : Identify your abilities : ${abilitiesStr}`);
    } else {
      lines.push('1d. Abilities : Identify your abilities : (blank)');
    }
    lines.push('');

    lines.push('--- B. CAREER EXPLORATION: WHERE AM I GOING? ---');
    lines.push('School and/or Community Experiences:');
    if (state.schoolExperiences.length) {
      state.schoolExperiences.forEach((e, i) => {
        lines.push(`  #${i + 1} What: ${e.what || '(blank)'}`);
        lines.push(`  #${i + 1} Skill Acquired: ${e.skill || '(blank)'}`);
      });
    } else {
      lines.push('  (none added yet)');
    }
    lines.push('Work Experiences:');
    if (state.workExperiences.length) {
      state.workExperiences.forEach((e, i) => {
        lines.push(`  #${i + 1} What: ${e.what || '(blank)'}`);
        lines.push(`  #${i + 1} Skill Acquired: ${e.skill || '(blank)'}`);
      });
    } else {
      lines.push('  (none added yet)');
    }
    const coi = state.careersOfInterest || { career: '', education: '', skills: '', workEnvironment: '' };
    lines.push('Careers of Interest and Characteristics:');
    lines.push(`  Careers of Interest: ${coi.career || '(blank)'}`);
    lines.push(`  Education Requirements: ${coi.education || '(blank)'}`);
    lines.push(`  Skills I Need to Acquire: ${coi.skills || '(blank)'}`);
    lines.push(`  Work Environment: ${coi.workEnvironment || '(blank)'}`);
    lines.push('');

    lines.push('--- C. FUTURE GOALS AND DECISION MAKING: HOW DO I GET THERE? ---');
    lines.push(`Goals (resulting from career exploration activities): ${state.careerGoal || '(blank)'}`);
    lines.push(`Education Plans (courses that relate to my career interests): ${state.needToLearn || '(blank)'}`);
    lines.push(`Action Steps (What I need to do to accomplish my goals): ${state.firstStep || '(blank)'}`);
    lines.push(`Completed Steps: ${state.completedSteps || 'No'}`);
    lines.push('');

    lines.push("--- SKILLS & APPLICATION ---");
    SKILLS.forEach((skill) => {
      const s = state.skills[skill.id] || {};
      const exp = s.choice === '__custom__' ? (s.custom || '(blank)') : (s.choice || '(blank)');
      lines.push(`${skill.officialName}: Level ${s.rating || 0}/5 | Experience: ${exp}`);
    });
    lines.push('');

    lines.push('--- CULMINATING ACTIVITY ---');
    lines.push('Activity: In 6th grade home and careers we are doing a unit on careers where we are looking at my interests, my values, what environment I perform best in and what careers are available to start working toward.');
    lines.push(`Self Knowledge / Future Plans: ${state.culminatingAnswer || '(blank)'}`);

    return lines.join('\n');
  }

  // ── Build a self-contained HTML download that mirrors MaiaLearning ──
  // Students open this file in a tab next to MaiaLearning and copy box-by-box.
  function buildFullCopyHTML() {
    const escH = (s) => String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');

    // Render one field block — value + MaiaLearning destination label + copy button.
    // If empty, shows a friendly warning instead of a copy button.
    const fld = (value, maiaLabel) => {
      const v = (value || '').trim();
      if (!v) {
        return `<div class="fld empty">
          <div class="fld-label">→ Pastes into: <strong>${escH(maiaLabel)}</strong></div>
          <div class="fld-empty">⚠ Empty — go back to the Scroll and fill this in.</div>
        </div>`;
      }
      return `<div class="fld">
        <div class="fld-label">→ Pastes into: <strong>${escH(maiaLabel)}</strong></div>
        <div class="fld-value">${escH(v)}</div>
        <button class="copy-btn" data-text="${escH(v)}">📋 Copy</button>
      </div>`;
    };

    const ordinals = ['1st', '2nd', '3rd'];
    const topThree = (arr) => (arr || [])
      .filter(x => x && x.trim())
      .map((v, i) => `${ordinals[i] || (i+1)+'th'}: ${v}`)
      .join('\n');
    const prefLabels = {
      people: 'Working with People',
      ideas:  'Working with Ideas',
      things: 'Working with Things',
    };
    const studentName = state.studentName || 'Traveler';

    // ─────── Section A ───────
    let secA = `
      <div class="section">
        <div class="section-title">A. Self Knowledge: Who am I?</div>

        <div class="subsection">
          <div class="subsection-desc">Interests : List your top three choices for each of the following areas of interest</div>
          <div class="row">
            <div class="grade-cell">Grade 6</div>
            ${fld(topThree(state.personalInterests), '1a. Personal : Out-of-school Activities you Enjoy')}
            ${fld(topThree(state.academicInterests), '1b. Academic : Classes or subjects you Enjoy the Most')}
            ${fld(prefLabels[state.workPreference] || '', '1c. Work Preference : Working with People, Ideas, and Things')}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="subsection">
          <div class="subsection-desc">Abilities : List personal skills and talents that will be helpful in a career choice</div>
          <div class="row">
            <div class="grade-cell">Grade 6</div>
            ${fld((state.abilities || []).filter(v => v.trim()).join(', '), 'My Personal Abilities')}
            ${fld((state.abilities || []).map(ab => ABILITY_CAREERS[ab]).filter(Boolean).join('; '), 'Career Areas Where my Abilities Will be Useful')}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="subsection">
          <div class="subsection-desc">Personal and academic areas I need to strengthen</div>
          ${(state.growth && state.growth.length ? state.growth : [{area:'', action:''}]).map(g => `
          <div class="row">
            <div class="grade-cell">Grade 6</div>
            ${fld(g.area, 'Areas I Need to Strengthen')}
            ${fld(g.action, 'Steps I Will Take to Strengthen These Areas')}
          </div>`).join('')}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    // ─────── Section B ───────
    const schoolRows = (state.schoolExperiences || []).filter(e => (e.what||'').trim() || (e.skill||'').trim());
    const workRows = (state.workExperiences || []).filter(e => (e.what||'').trim() || (e.skill||'').trim());
    const coi = state.careersOfInterest || { career: '', education: '', skills: '', workEnvironment: '' };

    let secB = `
      <div class="section">
        <div class="section-title">B. Career Exploration: Where am I going?</div>

        <div class="subsection">
          <div class="subsection-desc">Schools and/or Community Experiences : I have participated in the following school and/or community experiences</div>
          ${schoolRows.length ? schoolRows.map(e => `
          <div class="row">
            <div class="grade-cell">Grade 6</div>
            ${fld(e.what, 'School and/or Community Experiences')}
            ${fld(e.skill, 'Skills Acquired Through Experiences')}
          </div>`).join('') : `
          <div class="row">
            <div class="grade-cell">Grade 6</div>
            ${fld('', 'School and/or Community Experiences')}
            ${fld('', 'Skills Acquired Through Experiences')}
          </div>`}
        </div>

        <div class="subsection">
          <div class="subsection-desc">Work Experiences : I have participated in the following work experiences</div>
          ${workRows.length ? workRows.map(e => `
          <div class="row">
            <div class="grade-cell">Grade 6</div>
            ${fld(e.what, 'Work Experiences')}
            ${fld(e.skill, 'Skills Acquired Through Work Experience')}
          </div>`).join('') : `
          <div class="row">
            <div class="grade-cell">Grade 6</div>
            ${fld('', 'Work Experiences')}
            ${fld('', 'Skills Acquired Through Work Experience')}
          </div>`}
        </div>

        <div class="subsection">
          <div class="subsection-desc">Careers of Interest and Characteristics : I am interested in the following careers and have discovered the following information about these careers</div>
          <div class="row">
            <div class="grade-cell">Grade 6</div>
            ${fld(coi.career, 'Careers of Interest')}
            ${fld(coi.education, 'Education Requirements')}
            ${fld(coi.skills, 'Skills I Need to Acquire')}
            ${fld(coi.workEnvironment, 'Work Environment')}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    // ─────── Section C ───────
    let secC = `
      <div class="section">
        <div class="section-title">C. Future Goals and Decision Making : How do I get there?</div>
        <div class="subsection">
          <div class="subsection-desc">Career Goals and Action Steps</div>
          <div class="row">
            <div class="grade-cell">Grade 6</div>
            ${fld(state.careerGoal, 'Goals (resulting from career exploration activities)')}
            ${fld(state.needToLearn, 'Education Plans (courses that relate to my career interests)')}
            ${fld(state.firstStep, 'Action Steps (What I need to do to accomplish my goals)')}
            <div class="fld" style="flex:0 0 130px;">
              <div class="fld-label">→ Pastes into: <strong>Completed Steps</strong></div>
              <div class="fld-value" style="font-weight:700;text-align:center;font-size:1.1rem;">${escH(state.completedSteps || 'No')}</div>
              <div style="font-size:0.7rem;color:#64748b;margin-top:4px;text-align:center;">Pick this in MaiaLearning's dropdown</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    // ─────── Skills/Application ───────
    let skillsRows = SKILLS.map(skill => {
      const s = (state.skills && state.skills[skill.id]) || {};
      const ratingText = s.rating > 0 ? String(s.rating) : '';
      const expText = s.choice === '__custom__' ? (s.custom || '') : (s.choice || '');
      return `
        <div class="row skill-row">
          <div class="skill-name-cell"><strong>${escH(skill.officialName)}:</strong> ${escH(skill.desc)}</div>
          ${fld(ratingText, skill.officialName + ' — Beginning Skill Level I possess')}
          ${fld(expText, skill.officialName + ' — Experiences / Activities / Applications')}
        </div>`;
    }).join('');

    let secSkills = `
      <div class="section">
        <div class="section-title">Skills/Application</div>
        <div class="subsection">
          <div class="subsection-desc">For each skill in MaiaLearning, paste the level number into "Beginning Skill Level I possess" and the description into "Experiences / Activities / Applications". Leave "Final Skill Level I have achieved" blank — that gets filled in senior year.</div>
          ${skillsRows}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    // ─────── Culminating Activity (own pink section) ───────
    const culminatingActivityText = "In 6th grade home and careers we are doing a unit on careers where we are looking at my interests, my values, what environment I perform best in and what careers are available to start working toward.";
    let secCulminating = `
      <div class="section section-pink">
        <div class="section-title section-title-pink">🎯 Culminating Activity</div>
        <div class="subsection">
          <div class="subsection-desc">Briefly describe the activity that you completed. Indicate the most important thing you learned about yourself through this activity. Describe how this self knowledge will influence your plans for the future.</div>
          <div class="row">
            <div class="fld">
              <div class="fld-label">→ Pastes into: <strong>Activity</strong></div>
              <div class="fld-value">${escH(culminatingActivityText)}</div>
              <button class="copy-btn" data-text="${escH(culminatingActivityText)}">📋 Copy</button>
            </div>
            ${fld(state.culminatingAnswer, 'Self Knowledge / Future Plans')}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    // Final HTML doc — fully self-contained, works offline, has print stylesheet
    return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>${escH(studentName)}'s Career Map — Copy & Paste Sheet</title>
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
    background: #f1f5f9; color: #0f172a; padding: 24px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .container { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .header {
    background: #4f46e5; color: white; padding: 24px 28px;
    border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.25);
  }
  .header h1 { font-size: 1.6rem; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .header .subtitle { opacity: 0.9; font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .checklist {
    background: #fef3c7; border: 2px solid #fbbf24;
    padding: 18px 24px; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  .checklist h2 { color: #92400e; font-size: 1.15rem; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .checklist ol { margin: 0; padding-left: 24px; line-height: 1.8; color: #451a03; }
  .checklist ol li { margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .checklist strong { color: #78350f; }

  .section {
    background: white; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); overflow: hidden;
  }
  .section-title {
    background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; padding: 14px 20px;
    font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #fecaca;
  }
  /* Pink variant for Culminating Activity */
  .section.section-pink {
    border: 2px solid #fbcfe8;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.18);
  }
  .section-title.section-title-pink {
    background: #fce7f3;
    color: #be185d;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #fbcfe8;
  }
  .subsection { padding: 16px 20px; border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9; }
  .subsection:first-of-type { border-top: none; }
  .subsection-desc { font-size: 0.92rem; color: #334155; margin-bottom: 12px; }

  .row {
    display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: stretch;
    margin-top: 10px;
  }
  .grade-cell {
    flex: 0 0 70px; background: #f8fafc;
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .skill-name-cell {
    flex: 1.5; font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 8px;
    background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 4px;
  }
  .skill-row { align-items: stretch; }

  .fld {
    flex: 1; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px;
    background: white; padding: 10px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 110px;
  }
  .fld.empty { background: #fef2f2; border-color: #fca5a5; border-style: dashed; }
  .fld-label {
    font-size: 0.7rem; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .fld-label strong { color: #1e40af; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-size: 0.85rem; }
  .fld-value { flex: 1; white-space: pre-wrap; font-size: 0.92rem; color: #0f172a; padding: 4px 0; }
  .fld-empty {
    flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 0;
    color: #b91c1c; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.85rem;
  }
  .copy-btn {
    align-self: flex-end; margin-top: 8px;
    background: #4f46e5; color: white; border: none;
    padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s;
  }
  .copy-btn:hover { background: #3730a3; }
  .copy-btn.copied { background: #16a34a; }

  /* Print styles */
  @page { margin: 0.5in; }
  @media print {
    body { background: white; padding: 0; font-size: 10.5pt; }
    .copy-btn { display: none; }
    .header { background: white; color: black; box-shadow: none;
              border-bottom: 2px solid black; border-radius: 0;
              padding: 12px 0; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .header h1 { font-size: 1.3rem; }
    .checklist { display: none; }
    .section { box-shadow: none; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; page-break-inside: avoid;
               margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .section.section-pink { border: 1.5px solid #f472b6; }
    .section-title { padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 1rem; }
    .row { page-break-inside: avoid; }
    .fld { min-height: auto; padding: 8px; }
    .fld-label { font-size: 0.65rem; }
    .fld-value { font-size: 0.85rem; }
    .subsection { padding: 10px 14px; }
    .subsection-desc { font-size: 0.85rem; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="container">
    <div class="header">
      <h1>📜 ${escH(studentName)}'s Career Map</h1>
      <div class="subtitle">Copy &amp; Paste Sheet for the New York State Career Plan in MaiaLearning</div>
    </div>

    <div class="checklist">
      <h2>📋 How to use this page — 5 steps</h2>
      <ol>
        <li>Open <strong>this page</strong> in one tab.</li>
        <li>Open your <strong>school portal → MaiaLearning → Careers → Career Plan → New York State Career Plan</strong> in another tab.</li>
        <li>Put the two tabs <strong>side by side</strong>. Each box below tells you exactly which MaiaLearning box it goes in.</li>
        <li>Click <strong>📋 Copy</strong> on a box, then click into the matching MaiaLearning box and paste (Ctrl+V or ⌘+V).</li>
        <li>If a box says <strong style="color:#b91c1c;">⚠ Empty</strong>, go back to the Scroll of Destiny and fill it in, then download this file again.</li>
      </ol>
    </div>

    ${secA}
    ${secB}
    ${secC}
    ${secSkills}
    ${secCulminating}
  </div>

<script>
(function() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var text = btn.dataset.text || '';
      function done() {
        btn.classList.add('copied');
        var orig = btn.innerHTML;
        btn.innerHTML = '✓ Copied!';
        setTimeout(function() {
          btn.classList.remove('copied');
          btn.innerHTML = orig;
        }, 1400);
      }
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
