```html
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(function() {
          var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
          ta.value = text; ta.style.position='fixed'; ta.style.left='-9999px';
          document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
          try { document.execCommand('copy'); done(); } catch(e) {}
          document.body.removeChild(ta);
        });
      } else {
        var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
        ta.value = text; ta.style.position='fixed'; ta.style.left='-9999px';
        document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
        try { document.execCommand('copy'); done(); } catch(e) {}
        document.body.removeChild(ta);
      }
    });
  });
})();
<\/script>
</body>
</html>`;
  }

  // ── Clipboard ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  function copyToClipboard(text) {
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).catch(() => fallbackCopy(text));
    } else {
      fallbackCopy(text);
    }
  }

  function fallbackCopy(text) {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.left = '-9999px';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }

  // ── Toast ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function showToast(message) {
    const toast = $('#toast');
    if (!toast) return;
    toast.textContent = message;
    toast.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 2500);
  }

  // ── Custom confirm modal (window.confirm blocked in sandboxed iframes) ──────
  function showConfirmModal(message, onYes) {
    const ov = document.createElement('div');
    ov.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.75);z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';
    const box = document.createElement('div');
    box.style.cssText = 'background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border-accent);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:var(--space-2xl);max-width:400px;width:90%;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-glow);';
    box.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:2rem;margin-bottom:12px;">⚠️</div>' +
      '<div style="color:var(--text-primary);margin-bottom:24px;line-height:1.5;">' + message + '</div>' +
      '<div style="display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;">' +
      '<button id="_cm-yes" style="padding:10px 22px;background:var(--danger);border:none;border-radius:var(--radius-md);color:#fff;font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Yes, Reset</button>' +
      '<button id="_cm-no" style="padding:10px 22px;background:var(--bg-input);border:1px solid var(--border-default);border-radius:var(--radius-md);color:var(--text-primary);font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;">Cancel</button>' +
      '</div>';
    ov.appendChild(box);
    document.body.appendChild(ov);
    box.querySelector('#_cm-yes').addEventListener('click', function(){ document.body.removeChild(ov); onYes(); });
    box.querySelector('#_cm-no').addEventListener('click', function(){ document.body.removeChild(ov); });
  }

  // ── Reset ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function resetAll() {
    showConfirmModal('This will erase ALL your progress. Are you sure?', function() {
      state = initSkillsState(getDefaultState());
      saveState();
      initWelcome();
      initSelfKnowledge();
      initCareerExploration();
      initSkillsAssessment();
      initGoalSetting();
      navigateTo('welcome');
    });
  }

  // ── Welcome Screen ────────────────────────────────────────
  function initWelcome() {
    const nameInput = $('#student-name');
    if (nameInput) {
      nameInput.value = state.studentName || '';
      nameInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
        state.studentName = nameInput.value;
        debouncedSave();
      });
    }
  }

  function startJourney() {
    const nameInput = $('#student-name');
    if (nameInput && nameInput.value.trim()) {
      state.studentName = nameInput.value.trim();
      saveState();
    }
    
    // Set src and play audio on first user interaction (satisfies autoplay policy)
    const bgm = $('#bgm');
    const audioBtn = $('#audio-toggle');
    if (bgm) {
      if (!bgm.src || bgm.src === window.location.href) {
        bgm.src = 'The_Mages_Ledger.mp3';
      }
      bgm.volume = 0.4;
      bgm.play().then(() => {
        if (audioBtn) audioBtn.textContent = '🔊';
      }).catch(function() { /* audio blocked in iframe — silent */ });
    }

    navigateTo('self-knowledge');
  }

  // ── Mobile sidebar toggle ─────────────────────────────────
  function toggleSidebar() {
    const sidebar = $('.sidebar');
    if (sidebar) sidebar.classList.toggle('open');
  }

  // ── Initialize ────────────────────────────────────────────
  function init() {
    // Bind sidebar nav
    $$('.nav-item').forEach((item) => {
      item.addEventListener('click', () => {
        navigateTo(item.dataset.module);
        // Close mobile sidebar
        const sidebar = $('.sidebar');
        if (sidebar) sidebar.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });

    // Bind module next/prev buttons
    $$('[data-navigate]').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        navigateTo(btn.dataset.navigate);
      });
    });

    // Bind audio toggle
    const audioBtn = $('#audio-toggle');
    const bgm = $('#bgm');
    if (audioBtn && bgm) {
      audioBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (bgm.paused) {
          bgm.volume = 0.4;
          bgm.play();
          audioBtn.textContent = '🔊';
        } else {
          bgm.pause();
          audioBtn.textContent = '🔇';
        }
      });
    }

    // Bind begin journey
    const beginBtn = $('#begin-btn');
    if (beginBtn) {
      beginBtn.addEventListener('click', startJourney);
    }

    // Bind add experience buttons
    const addSchoolBtn = $('#add-school-exp');
    if (addSchoolBtn) {
      addSchoolBtn.addEventListener('click', () => addExperience('school'));
    }
    const addWorkBtn = $('#add-work-exp');
    if (addWorkBtn) {
      addWorkBtn.addEventListener('click', () => addExperience('work'));
    }

    // Bind reset
    const resetBtn = $('#reset-btn');
    if (resetBtn) {
      resetBtn.addEventListener('click', resetAll);
    }

    // (Save/Load Journey removed)

    // Bind mobile toggle
    const mobileBtn = $('#mobile-toggle');
    if (mobileBtn) {
      mobileBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleSidebar);
    }

    // Initialize modules
    initWelcome();
    initSelfKnowledge();
    initCareerExploration();
    initSkillsAssessment();
    initGoalSetting();

    // Navigate to saved position
    navigateTo(state.currentModule || 'welcome');
  }

  // Run when DOM is ready
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
  <div class="toast" id="grid-toast">Limit reached!</div>
</body>
</html>
```
